# **I. Overview** {#i.-overview}

## **1\. Code Packages** {#1.-code-packages}

![][image2]  
***Package descriptions***

| No | Package | Description |
| ----- | :---- | :---- |
| 01 | Config | Contains configuration classes used to initialize and configure the application, such as database connections, application settings, and framework configurations.  |
| 02 | Controller | Contains controller classes responsible for handling client requests, processing input, coordinating application logic, and returning appropriate responses or views.  |
| 03 | Security | Contains classes responsible for application security, including authentication, authorization, password handling, and access control.  |
| 04 | Service | Contains service classes that implement the application's business logic and coordinate operations between controllers and repositories.  |
| 05 | DTO | Contains Data Transfer Object classes used to transfer data between different layers of the application while controlling the data exposed between components.  |
| 06 | Repository | Contains repository classes responsible for accessing and managing data in the database, including querying, inserting, updating, and deleting records.  |
| 07 | Exception | Contains custom exception classes used to handle and represent application-specific errors and exceptional situations.  |
| 08 | Util | Contains utility and helper classes that provide reusable functions for common tasks used throughout the application.  |
| 09 | Entity | Contains entity classes that represent the main business objects and their corresponding data structures used by the application.  |

### ***b. Table Description*** {#b.-table-description}

#### 

| No | Table | Description |
| ----- | :---- | :---- |
| 01 | roles | Role definitions: ROLE\_ADMIN, ROLE\_STAFF, ROLE\_MEMBER. \- **id (PK)** \- name |
| 02 | users | User accounts and Wallet balance. \- **id (PK)** \- email \- password \- full\_name \- avatar\_url \- wallet\_balance \- auth\_provider \- status \- created\_at \- updated\_at |
| 03 | user\_roles | Many-to-many relationship between users and roles. \- **user\_id (PK, FK)** \- **role\_id (PK, FK)** |
| 04 | email\_verification\_tokens | OTP codes for email account activation. \- **id (PK) \-** user\_id (FK) \- otp\_code \- expiry\_date \- created\_at |
| 05 | categories | Novel categories/genres list. \- **id (PK)** \- name \- slug \- description |
| 06 | novels | Information about novels managed by Staff/Admin. \- **id (PK)** \- title \- author \- summary \- cover\_url \- status \- is\_deleted \- uploader\_id (FK) \- views \- average\_rating \- rating\_count \- created\_at \- updated\_at |
| 07 | novel\_categories | Many-to-many relationship for multi-category classification of novels. \- **novel\_id (PK, FK)** \- category\_id (PK, FK) |
| 08 | novel\_ratings | Star rating and review system for novels. \- **id (PK)** \- novel\_id (FK) \- user\_id (FK) \- rating \- review\_text \- created\_at \- updated\_at |
| 09 | chapters | Novel chapter content and VIP coin pricing settings. \- **id (PK)** \- novel\_id (FK) \- chapter\_number \- title \- content \- price \- auto\_unlock\_at \- views \- status \- is\_deleted \- created\_at \- updated\_at |
| 10 | bookshelves | Reader's personal bookshelf. \- **id (PK)** \- user\_id (FK) \- novel\_id (FK) \- added\_at |
| 11 | user\_chapter\_activities | Combines reading history, VIP unlocks, and reading progress. \- **id (PK)** \- user\_id (FK) \- chapter\_id (FK) \- is\_read \- read\_at \- is\_unlocked \- price\_paid \- unlocked\_at |
| 12 | comments | Reader comments on chapters. \- **id (PK)** \- user\_id (FK) \- chapter\_id (FK) \- content \- status \- created\_at \- updated\_at |
| 13 | comment\_reports | Reports of toxic comments or policy violations. \- **id (PK)** \- user\_id (FK) \- comment\_id (FK) \- reason \- status \- admin\_note \- resolved\_by (FK) \- created\_at \- processed\_at |
| 14 | content\_reports | Reports for content violations or chapter-level errors. \- **id (PK)** \- user\_id (FK) \- chapter\_id (FK) \- reason \- status \- admin\_note \- resolved\_by (FK) \- created\_at \- processed\_at |
| 15 | notifications | System or personal notification inbox. \- **id (PK)** \- user\_id (FK) \- title \- content \- is\_read \- created\_at |
| 16 | coin\_packages | List of coin top-up packages. \- **id (PK)** \- name \- price \- coin\_amount \- status \- created\_at |
| 17 | topup\_orders | Top-up orders for coin deposit. \- **id (PK)** \- user\_id (FK) \- package\_id (FK) \- order\_code \- amount\_vnd \- coin\_received \- status \- payment\_method \- bank\_transaction\_code \- paid\_at \- created\_at \- updated\_at |
| 18 | payment\_logs | Technical tracing for IPN/Webhook from banks/payment gateways. \- **id (PK)** \- order\_code (FK) \- raw\_payload \- ip\_address \- status \- created\_at |
| 19 | transactions | Wallet ledger recording actual balance changes. \- **id (PK)** \- user\_id (FK) \- amount \- balance\_after \- type \- reference\_id \- description \- created\_by (FK) \- created\_at |
| 20 | system\_settings | General system configurations (exchange rates, support email, policies). \- **setting\_key (PK)** \- setting\_value \- description \- updated\_by (FK) \- updated\_at |
| 21 | web\_settings | Web interface settings (themes replacement). \- **id (PK)** \- name \- folder\_path \- thumbnail\_url \- is\_active \- uploaded\_by (FK) \- created\_at \- updated\_at |
| 22 | system\_audit\_logs | Activity logs for Admin/Staff to prevent power abuse. \- **id (PK)** \- admin\_id (FK) \- action\_type \- target\_entity \- target\_id \- old\_value \- new\_value \- ip\_address \- created\_at |
| 23 | user\_login\_logs | Member login logs for dispute resolution. \- **id (PK)** \- user\_id (FK) \- ip\_address \- user\_agent \- status \- created\_at |
| 24 | user\_daily\_checkins | Daily check-in history for members. \- **id (PK)** \- user\_id (FK) \- checkin\_date \- reward\_coin \- streak\_count \- created\_at |
| 25 | user\_reader\_themes | Personalization settings for the reader view. \- **user\_id (PK, FK)** \- font\_family \- font\_size \- theme\_mode \- audio\_voice \- audio\_speed \- updated\_at |

# **II. Code Designs** {#ii.-code-designs}

## **1\. Authentication & Security** {#1.-authentication-&-security}

### *1.1 Register Account* {#1.1-register-account}

#### ***a. Class Diagram***

![][image4] 

#### ***b. Class Specifications***

***AuthController Class***

| No | Method | Description |
| :---: | :---- | :---- |
| 01 | **AuthController(authService: AuthService)** | **Purpose:** Constructor for initializing the authentication controller with required dependencies. **Inputs:** *authService: AuthService* – Authentication business service component. **Outputs:** Newly created instance of *AuthController*. **Internal processing:** Assigns the injected *AuthService* dependency to the controller's private final field via constructor-based dependency injection. |
| 02 | **showRegistrationForm(redirect: String, request: HttpServletRequest, authentication: Authentication, model: Model): String** | **Purpose:** Handles HTTP GET /register requests to display the user registration form. **Inputs:** • *redirect: String* – Optional return URL parameter upon post-registration redirect. • *request: HttpServletRequest* – Current HTTP request to access the user session. • *authentication: Authentication* – Spring Security authentication principal of the current caller. • *model: Model* – Spring MVC Model used to pass attributes to the view template. **Outputs:** Returns String view name ("redirect:/" if already authenticated, or "authentication/register" to render the registration form). **Internal processing:** 1\. Checks if the user is already logged in (authenticated and not an AnonymousAuthenticationToken); if true, returns "redirect:/". 2\. Validates the target redirect URL using CustomAuthenticationSuccessHandler.isValidRedirectUrl(); stores it in session or model if valid. 3\. Instantiates a blank RegisterRequestDTO and binds it to the model under the attribute name "userDto" for form data binding. 4\. Returns the view template name "authentication/register". |
| 03 | **processRegistration(userDto: RegisterRequestDTO, bindingResult: BindingResult, model: Model, redirectAttributes: RedirectAttributes): String** | **Purpose:** Handles HTTP POST /register requests to validate and process user account registration. **Inputs:** • *userDto: RegisterRequestDTO* – Form data transfer object containing fullName, email, password, and confirmPassword (validated with @Valid). • *bindingResult: BindingResult* – Spring validation result holder containing JSR-380 field validation errors. • *model: Model* – UI Model used to return business error messages to the view. • *redirectAttributes: RedirectAttributes* – Flash attribute container for cross-redirect feedback. **Outputs:** Returns String view name ("authentication/register" on failure, or "redirect:/verify-otp?email=" \+ email on success). **Internal processing:** 1\. Checks bindingResult.hasErrors(); if validation errors exist (e.g. blank fields, invalid email format, short password), returns "authentication/register" immediately to render field error messages. 2\. Invokes authService.registerUser(userDto) within a try-catch block. 3\. If an IllegalArgumentException is caught (e.g. email already registered, or confirm password does not match), adds errorMessage to the model and returns "authentication/register". 4\. If an unexpected exception occurs, logs error details, attaches a generic system error message, and returns "authentication/register". 5\. Upon successful user creation and OTP dispatch, attaches a flash success message ("Đăng ký thành công\! Vui lòng kiểm tra email để nhận mã OTP.") and redirects the user to "redirect:/verify-otp?email=" \+ userDto.getEmail(). |

***AuthService Interface***

| No | Method | Description |
| :---: | :---- | :---- |
| 01 | **registerUser(requestDTO: RegisterRequestDTO): void** | **Purpose:** Business service interface contract defining the operation to register a new user account. **Inputs:** *requestDTO: RegisterRequestDTO* – Encapsulates registration credentials (fullName, email, password, confirmPassword). **Outputs:** *void*. Throws *IllegalArgumentException* if business validation rules fail. **Internal processing:** Contract specification for verifying unique email constraints, verifying password matching, hashing raw passwords with BCrypt, persisting a new user with default role ROLE\_MEMBER and PENDING\_VERIFICATION status, generating a 6-digit OTP verification token, and triggering the notification email. |

***AuthServiceImpl Class***

| No | Method | Description |
| :---: | :---- | :---- |
| 01 | **AuthServiceImpl(userRepository: UserRepository, roleRepository: RoleRepository, tokenRepository: EmailVerificationTokenRepository, passwordEncoder: PasswordEncoder, emailService: EmailService)** | **Purpose:** Constructor injecting all necessary data access and utility dependencies for authentication management. **Inputs:** • *userRepository: UserRepository* – User data access repository. • *roleRepository: RoleRepository* – Role data access repository. • *tokenRepository: EmailVerificationTokenRepository* – Verification token repository. • *passwordEncoder: PasswordEncoder* – Spring Security BCrypt password hashing implementation. • *emailService: EmailService* – Email communication service. **Outputs:** Newly created instance of *AuthServiceImpl*. **Internal processing:** Assigns all supplied dependency beans to the class's private final fields for dependency injection. |
| 02 | **registerUser(requestDTO: RegisterRequestDTO): void** | **Purpose:** Executes business transactions for registering a new user account with OTP email verification. **Inputs:** *requestDTO: RegisterRequestDTO* – DTO carrying full name, email, password, and confirmation password. **Outputs:** *void*. Throws *IllegalArgumentException* if the email is already in use or passwords mismatch. **Internal processing:** 1\. Executes userRepository.existsByEmail(requestDTO.getEmail()); if true, throws IllegalArgumentException("Email đã được sử dụng"). 2\. Checks whether requestDTO.getPassword().equals(requestDTO.getConfirmPassword()); if false, throws IllegalArgumentException("Mật khẩu xác nhận không khớp"). 3\. Hashes the plaintext password using passwordEncoder.encode(requestDTO.getPassword()). 4\. Builds a new User entity populated with email, encoded password, full name, status "PENDING\_VERIFICATION", auth provider "LOCAL", and wallet balance 0\. 5\. Retrieves ROLE\_MEMBER from roleRepository.findByName("ROLE\_MEMBER") (creates and persists it if missing), and associates it with the user's role set. 6\. Persists the new user in the database via userRepository.save(user). 7\. Generates a secure random 6-digit numeric OTP code (String.format("%06d", random.nextInt(1000000))). 8\. Constructs an EmailVerificationToken entity referencing the persisted user, with an expiry timestamp set to 15 minutes in the future (now \+ 15 minutes), and saves it via tokenRepository.save(token). 9\. Dispatches the verification email containing the OTP code via emailService.sendOtpEmail(user.getEmail(), otp). |

***EmailService Interface***

| No | Method | Description |
| :---: | :---- | :---- |
| 01 | **sendOtpEmail(toEmail: String, otpCode: String): void** | **Purpose:** Interface contract for sending a registration verification OTP code to a user's email address. **Inputs:** • *toEmail: String* – Recipient email address. • *otpCode: String* – 6-digit numeric OTP verification code. **Outputs:** *void*. Throws *org.springframework.mail.MailException* on email transmission failure. **Internal processing:** Contract specification for building an email notification containing the OTP verification code and dispatching it to the recipient's inbox. |

***EmailServiceImpl Class***

| No | Method | Description |
| :---: | :---- | :---- |
| 01 | **EmailServiceImpl(mailSender: JavaMailSender)** | **Purpose:** Constructor initializing the email service implementation with Spring's mail sender. **Inputs:** *mailSender: JavaMailSender* – Spring mail sender bean configured with SMTP settings. **Outputs:** Newly created instance of *EmailServiceImpl*. **Internal processing:** Injects and binds the JavaMailSender instance to the private final field mailSender. |
| 02 | **sendOtpEmail(toEmail: String, otpCode: String): void** | **Purpose:** Creates and dispatches an OTP email message for account registration verification. **Inputs:** • *toEmail: String* – Recipient's destination email address. • *otpCode: String* – 6-digit numeric OTP code. **Outputs:** *void*. **Internal processing:** 1\. Instantiates a SimpleMailMessage object. 2\. Sets recipient address to toEmail. 3\. Sets email subject line to "Mã xác nhận đăng ký tài khoản Trạm Truyện". 4\. Builds the message body specifying the OTP code, 15-minute expiration window, and security advice. 5\. Invokes mailSender.send(message) to transmit the email via SMTP. |

***RegisterRequestDTO Class***

| No | Method | Description |
| :---: | :---- | :---- |
| 01 | **getFullName(): String** | **Inputs:** None. **Outputs:** *String* – Full name of the user registering an account. **Internal processing:** Retrieves and returns the private *fullName* field value. |
| 02 | **setFullName(fullName: String): void** | **Inputs:** *fullName: String* – Full name string submitted from the registration form. **Outputs:** *void*. **Internal processing:** Assigns the provided parameter to the private *fullName* field. |
| 03 | **getEmail(): String** | **Inputs:** None. **Outputs:** *String* – Email address submitted by the user. **Internal processing:** Retrieves and returns the private *email* field value. |
| 04 | **setEmail(email: String): void** | **Inputs:** *email: String* – Email address entered into the registration form. **Outputs:** *void*. **Internal processing:** Assigns the provided parameter to the private *email* field. |
| 05 | **getPassword(): String** | **Inputs:** None. **Outputs:** *String* – Raw password string entered by the user. **Internal processing:** Retrieves and returns the private *password* field value. |
| 06 | **setPassword(password: String): void** | **Inputs:** *password: String* – Raw password string from form input. **Outputs:** *void*. **Internal processing:** Assigns the input string to the private *password* field. |
| 07 | **getConfirmPassword(): String** | **Inputs:** None. **Outputs:** *String* – Confirmation password string entered by the user. **Internal processing:** Retrieves and returns the private *confirmPassword* field value. |
| 08 | **setConfirmPassword(confirmPassword: String): void** | **Inputs:** *confirmPassword: String* – Confirmation password input string. **Outputs:** *void*. **Internal processing:** Assigns the input string to the private *confirmPassword* field. |

***UserRepository Interface***

| No | Method | Description |
| :---: | :---- | :---- |
| 01 | **existsByEmail(email: String): boolean** | **Purpose:** Checks whether an active or pending account with the specified email address already exists. **Inputs:** *email: String* – Email address to query. **Outputs:** *boolean* – *true* if a user with the given email exists in the database; *false* otherwise. **Internal processing:** Spring Data JPA executes an optimized count query (SELECT COUNT(\*) \> 0 FROM users WHERE email \= ?) against PostgreSQL. |
| 02 | **save(user: User): User** | **Purpose:** Persists a new user record or updates an existing one in the database. **Inputs:** *user: User* – User entity containing profile and credential fields. **Outputs:** *User* – Persisted entity with assigned database primary key (id) and audit timestamps. **Internal processing:** Executes SQL INSERT INTO users (...) via Hibernate's EntityManager within the current transaction context. |

***RoleRepository Interface***

| No | Method | Description |
| :---: | :---- | :---- |
| 01 | **findByName(name: String): Optional\<Role\>** | **Purpose:** Retrieves a system security role record by its unique identifier name. **Inputs:** *name: String* – Standardized role name (e.g., "ROLE\_MEMBER"). **Outputs:** *Optional\<Role\>* – An Optional containing the matched Role entity if found, or empty otherwise. **Internal processing:** Executes a query against the roles table (SELECT \* FROM roles WHERE name \= ?) using Spring Data JPA. |
| 02 | **save(role: Role): Role** | **Purpose:** Persists a new role record into the database. **Inputs:** *role: Role* – Role entity to persist. **Outputs:** *Role* – Persisted Role entity with generated primary key. **Internal processing:** Executes an SQL INSERT or UPDATE statement against the roles table via JPA. |

***EmailVerificationTokenRepository Interface***

| No | Method | Description |
| :---: | :---- | :---- |
| 01 | **save(token: EmailVerificationToken): EmailVerificationToken** | **Purpose:** Persists an email verification token record containing an OTP code and expiration timestamp. **Inputs:** *token: EmailVerificationToken* – Token entity referencing a specific user. **Outputs:** *EmailVerificationToken* – Persisted token entity with populated primary key. **Internal processing:** Executes SQL INSERT INTO email\_verification\_tokens (...) via Hibernate. |
| 02 | **findByOtpCodeAndUser(otpCode: String, user: User): Optional\<EmailVerificationToken\>** | **Purpose:** Finds an OTP verification token belonging to a specific user for activation validation. **Inputs:** • *otpCode: String* – OTP code submitted by user. • *user: User* – Associated user entity. **Outputs:** *Optional\<EmailVerificationToken\>* – Wrapped token entity if matched, or empty Optional. **Internal processing:** Executes a parameterized SQL query: SELECT \* FROM email\_verification\_tokens WHERE otp\_code \= ? AND user\_id \= ?. |
| 03 | **deleteByUser(user: User): void** | **Purpose:** Deletes all verification tokens associated with a given user entity. **Inputs:** *user: User* – User entity whose tokens should be purged. **Outputs:** *void*. **Internal processing:** Executes a delete query (DELETE FROM email\_verification\_tokens WHERE user\_id \= ?) to clean up expired or consumed OTP tokens. |

***User Class***

| No | Method | Description |
| :---: | :---- | :---- |
| 01 | **getId(): Integer** | **Inputs:** None. **Outputs:** *Integer* – Unique database primary key of the user. **Internal processing:** Returns the private *id* field value. |
| 02 | **setId(id: Integer): void** | **Inputs:** *id: Integer* – Database primary key. **Outputs:** *void*. **Internal processing:** Sets the private *id* property of the user. |
| 03 | **getEmail(): String** | **Inputs:** None. **Outputs:** *String* – User email address. **Internal processing:** Returns the private *email* field value. |
| 04 | **setEmail(email: String): void** | **Inputs:** *email: String* – Email address. **Outputs:** *void*. **Internal processing:** Assigns the provided parameter to the private *email* field. |
| 05 | **getPassword(): String** | **Inputs:** None. **Outputs:** *String* – Encrypted BCrypt password hash. **Internal processing:** Returns the private *password* field value. |
| 06 | **setPassword(password: String): void** | **Inputs:** *password: String* – Hashed password string. **Outputs:** *void*. **Internal processing:** Assigns the hashed password to the private *password* field. |
| 07 | **getFullName(): String** | **Inputs:** None. **Outputs:** *String* – Full name of the user. **Internal processing:** Returns the private *fullName* field value. |
| 08 | **setFullName(fullName: String): void** | **Inputs:** *fullName: String* – Full name string. **Outputs:** *void*. **Internal processing:** Assigns the parameter to the private *fullName* field. |

#### ***b. Class Specifications***

***AuthController Class***

| No | Method | Description |
| :---: | :---- | :---- |
| 01 | **AuthController(authService: AuthService)** | **Purpose:** Constructor initializing the authentication controller with required service dependencies. **Inputs:** *authService: AuthService* – Business service handling authentication logic. **Outputs:** Newly created instance of *AuthController*. **Internal processing:** Injects and binds the *AuthService* instance to the private final field via Spring constructor dependency injection. |
| 02 | **showLoginForm(redirect: String, request: HttpServletRequest, authentication: Authentication, model: Model): String** | **Purpose:** Handles HTTP GET /login requests to display the login page containing local form login and the Google OAuth2 login button. **Inputs:** • *redirect: String* – Optional query parameter designating the return destination URL after login. • *request: HttpServletRequest* – Current HTTP servlet request to access the user session. • *authentication: Authentication* – Current Spring Security authentication principal. • *model: Model* – UI Model to pass view attributes. **Outputs:** Returns String view name ("redirect:/" if already authenticated, or "authentication/login" to render the login view). **Internal processing:** 1\. Checks if the user is already authenticated (and not an AnonymousAuthenticationToken); if true, returns "redirect:/". 2\. Retrieves any stored return URL from the query parameter or session attribute "REDIRECT\_URL". 3\. Validates the return URL via CustomAuthenticationSuccessHandler.isValidRedirectUrl(); saves it to session and model if valid. 4\. Returns the view template path "authentication/login". |

***SecurityConfig Class***

| No | Method | Description |
| :---: | :---- | :---- |
| 01 | **filterChain(http: HttpSecurity): SecurityFilterChain** | **Purpose:** Configures Spring Security HTTP filter chain and authentication mechanisms including Google OAuth2. **Inputs:** *http: HttpSecurity* – Spring Security HTTP configuration builder. **Outputs:** *SecurityFilterChain* – Configured security filter chain bean. **Internal processing:** 1\. Configures CSRF protection (ignoring /api/\*\* endpoints). 2\. Sets up URL authorization permissions (public access for /login, /register, static assets; ROLE\_ADMIN for /admin/\*\*; ROLE\_STAFF for /staff/\*\*; authenticated for /user/\*\*, /wallet/\*\*). 3\. Configures formLogin and oauth2Login with loginPage("/login"). 4\. Registers CustomOAuth2UserService for Google UserInfo processing. 5\. Binds CustomAuthenticationSuccessHandler and CustomAuthenticationFailureHandler for post-authentication routing and error handling. 6\. Adds UserStatusCheckFilter before AuthorizationFilter to enforce real-time ban checking. |

***CustomOAuth2UserService Class***

| No | Method | Description |
| :---: | :---- | :---- |
| 01 | **CustomOAuth2UserService(userRepository: UserRepository, roleRepository: RoleRepository, accountLockService: AccountLockService)** | **Purpose:** Constructor injecting persistence repositories and lock management services for OAuth2 processing. **Inputs:** • *userRepository: UserRepository* – User data access repository. • *roleRepository: RoleRepository* – Role data access repository. • *accountLockService: AccountLockService* – Service for evaluating user ban/lock statuses. **Outputs:** Newly created instance of *CustomOAuth2UserService*. **Internal processing:** Injects and binds all dependencies to private final fields via constructor injection. |
| 02 | **loadUser(userRequest: OAuth2UserRequest): OAuth2User** | **Purpose:** Processes Google OAuth2 authentication by fetching user profile data and provisioning/updating local user accounts. **Inputs:** *userRequest: OAuth2UserRequest* – Carries OAuth2 client registration information and Google access token. **Outputs:** *OAuth2User* (CustomUserDetails instance). Throws *OAuth2AuthenticationException* if the user account is locked/banned. **Internal processing:** 1\. Calls super.loadUser(userRequest) to obtain user attributes (email, name, picture) from Google. 2\. Queries userRepository.findByEmail(email). 3\. If existing user: checks if status is "BANNED"; invokes accountLockService.checkAndAutoUnban(user). If still banned, throws OAuth2AuthenticationException with code "account\_locked". Otherwise updates avatar if empty, updates authProvider to "GOOGLE", sets status to "ACTIVE" if pending, and persists via userRepository.save(user). 4\. If new user: builds User entity with email, name, avatarUrl, authProvider "GOOGLE", status "ACTIVE", walletBalance 0\. Finds/creates ROLE\_MEMBER and assigns it to user. Persists via userRepository.save(user). 5\. Returns new CustomUserDetails(user, attributes). |

***CustomAuthenticationSuccessHandler Class***

| No | Method | Description |
| :---: | :---- | :---- |
| 01 | **CustomAuthenticationSuccessHandler()** | **Purpose:** Constructor initializing default redirection targets. **Inputs:** None. **Outputs:** Newly created instance. **Internal processing:** Sets the default fallback redirection target URL to "/". |
| 02 | **onAuthenticationSuccess(request: HttpServletRequest, response: HttpServletResponse, authentication: Authentication): void** | **Purpose:** Handles post-login routing upon successful Google OAuth2 authentication. **Inputs:** • *request: HttpServletRequest* – Current HTTP request. • *response: HttpServletResponse* – HTTP response used to perform redirection. • *authentication: Authentication* – Authentication token holding granted roles. **Outputs:** *void*. **Internal processing:** 1\. Checks priority order for redirect destination: explicit "redirect" parameter, session attribute "REDIRECT\_URL", or Spring Security SavedRequest. 2\. If authenticated user has ROLE\_ADMIN, redirects to /admin/novels (or valid /admin target). 3\. If user has ROLE\_STAFF, redirects to /staff/novels (or valid /staff target). 4\. For standard members, redirects to the requested valid return URL or "/". 5\. Clears authentication session attributes before triggering redirection. |
| 03 | **isValidRedirectUrl(url: String): boolean** | **Purpose:** Validates target redirection URLs to prevent Open Redirect security vulnerabilities. **Inputs:** *url: String* – URL string to validate. **Outputs:** *boolean* – true if relative, secure, and matching allowed paths; false otherwise. **Internal processing:** Checks that URL starts with "/", does not contain scheme identifiers (http:, https:), "//", or backslashes, and matches whitelisted application route prefixes. |
| 04 | **extractRelativePath(fullUrl: String): String** | **Purpose:** Extracts relative path component from full absolute URLs stored in SavedRequest. **Inputs:** *fullUrl: String* – Absolute URL string. **Outputs:** *String* – Relative URI path including query string. **Internal processing:** Parses URI and extracts the path and query portions. |

***CustomAuthenticationFailureHandler Class***

| No | Method | Description |
| :---: | :---- | :---- |
| 01 | **CustomAuthenticationFailureHandler(accountLockService: AccountLockService)** | **Purpose:** Constructor initializing the failure handler with the account lock service. **Inputs:** *accountLockService: AccountLockService* – Service for retrieving lock/ban details. **Outputs:** Newly created instance. **Internal processing:** Stores the accountLockService dependency. |
| 02 | **onAuthenticationFailure(request: HttpServletRequest, response: HttpServletResponse, exception: AuthenticationException): void** | **Purpose:** Intercepts authentication failures and redirects banned/locked Google users to the ban details notice page. **Inputs:** • *request: HttpServletRequest* – Current request. • *response: HttpServletResponse* – Response used for redirect. • *exception: AuthenticationException* – Authentication exception thrown during login. **Outputs:** *void*. **Internal processing:** 1\. Checks if exception is OAuth2AuthenticationException with error code "account\_locked". 2\. Extracts email from error description. 3\. Invokes accountLockService.buildAccountLockedInfo(email) to retrieve detailed ban reasons and durations. 4\. Stores the AccountLockedInfoDTO into session attribute "LOCKED\_USER\_INFO". 5\. Redirects user to "/account-locked". For other exceptions, redirects to "/login?error". |

***AccountLockService Class***

| No | Method | Description |
| :---: | :---- | :---- |
| 01 | **checkAndAutoUnban(user: User): boolean** | **Purpose:** Verifies whether a temporary ban has expired; automatically restores user status to ACTIVE if expiration time has passed. **Inputs:** *user: User* – Target user entity with status "BANNED". **Outputs:** *boolean* – true if the user was unbanned; false if the ban remains active or permanent. **Internal processing:** 1\. Queries systemAuditLogRepository for latest "BAN\_USER" audit record targeting this user. 2\. Parses ban expiration timestamp (banExpiresAt) from JSON audit log. 3\. If ban is temporary and current time is after expiresAt, updates status to "ACTIVE" and saves via userRepository. 4\. Logs an "AUTO\_UNBAN" audit record to system\_audit\_logs and returns true. |
| 02 | **buildAccountLockedInfo(email: String): AccountLockedInfoDTO** | **Purpose:** Builds and populates ban details DTO to present informative notice to locked users. **Inputs:** *email: String* – Email address of the locked user. **Outputs:** *AccountLockedInfoDTO* – Populated DTO containing ban reasons, dates, reviewer, and support email. **Internal processing:** Queries userRepository for user entity; fetches latest BAN\_USER audit log; extracts ban reason, duration, reviewer name, and ticket reference number; formats dates into localized display strings and constructs AccountLockedInfoDTO. |

AND target\_id \= ? AND action\_type \= ? ORDER BY created\_at DESC LIMIT 1\. |

#### ***d. Database Queries***

SELECT \* FROM users WHERE email \= ?;

INSERT INTO users (email, full\_name, avatar\_url, auth\_provider, status, wallet\_balance, created\_at, updated\_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, 'GOOGLE', 'ACTIVE', 0, ?, ?);

INSERT INTO user\_roles (user\_id, role\_id) VALUES (?, ?);

***AuthController Class***

| No | Method | Description |
| :---: | :---- | :---- |
| 01 | **AuthController(authService: AuthService)** | **Purpose:** Constructor initializing the authentication controller with required service dependencies. **Inputs:** *authService: AuthService* – Business service handling authentication logic. **Outputs:** Newly created instance of *AuthController*. **Internal processing:** Injects and binds the *AuthService* instance to the private final field via Spring constructor dependency injection. |
| 02 | **showLoginForm(redirect: String, request: HttpServletRequest, authentication: Authentication, model: Model): String** | **Purpose:** Handles HTTP GET /login requests to display the user login page. **Inputs:** • *redirect: String* – Optional query parameter designating the return destination URL after login. • *request: HttpServletRequest* – Current HTTP servlet request to access the user session. • *authentication: Authentication* – Current Spring Security authentication principal. • *model: Model* – UI Model to pass view attributes. **Outputs:** Returns String view name ("redirect:/" if already authenticated, or "authentication/login" to render the login view). **Internal processing:** 1\. Checks if the user is already authenticated (and not an AnonymousAuthenticationToken); if true, returns "redirect:/". 2\. Retrieves any stored return URL from the query parameter or session attribute "REDIRECT\_URL". 3\. Validates the return URL via CustomAuthenticationSuccessHandler.isValidRedirectUrl(); saves it to session and model if valid. 4\. Returns the view template path "authentication/login". |

***SecurityConfig Class***

| No | Method | Description |
| :---: | :---- | :---- |
| 01 | **passwordEncoder(): PasswordEncoder** | **Purpose:** Defines the password encryption bean for the application. **Inputs:** None. **Outputs:** *PasswordEncoder* – Instance of BCryptPasswordEncoder. **Internal processing:** Instantiates and returns a BCryptPasswordEncoder bean used by Spring Security DaoAuthenticationProvider to verify login credentials. |
| 02 | **filterChain(http: HttpSecurity): SecurityFilterChain** | **Purpose:** Configures Spring Security HTTP filter chain and authentication mechanisms including form login. **Inputs:** *http: HttpSecurity* – Spring Security HTTP configuration builder. **Outputs:** *SecurityFilterChain* – Configured security filter chain bean. **Internal processing:** 1\. Configures CSRF protection (ignoring /api/\*\* endpoints). 2\. Sets up URL authorization permissions (public access for /login, /register, static assets; ROLE\_ADMIN for /admin/\*\*; ROLE\_STAFF for /staff/\*\*; authenticated for /user/\*\*, /wallet/\*\*). 3\. Configures formLogin with loginPage("/login"), loginProcessingUrl("/login"). 4\. Binds CustomAuthenticationSuccessHandler and CustomAuthenticationFailureHandler for post-authentication routing and error handling. 5\. Configures rememberMe authentication (30-day validity, key, userDetailsService). 6\. Configures logout and registers UserStatusCheckFilter before AuthorizationFilter to enforce real-time ban checking. |

| No | Method | Description |

| 01 | **CustomUserDetailsService(userRepository: UserRepository, accountLockService: AccountLockService)** | **Purpose:** Constructor initializing user details service with persistence and account lock handling dependencies. **Inputs:** • *userRepository: UserRepository* – User data access repository. • *accountLockService: AccountLockService* – Service for evaluating user ban/lock statuses. **Outputs:** Newly created instance of *CustomUserDetailsService*. **Internal processing:** Injects and binds dependencies to private final fields via constructor dependency injection. |

Throws UsernameNotFoundException("Không tìm thấy tài khoản với email: " \+ username) if the user record does not exist. 3\. If the user status is "BANNED", invokes accountLockService.checkAndAutoUnban(user) to check and auto-restore status if temporary ban duration has expired. 4\. Wraps and returns new CustomUserDetails(user). |

***CustomAuthenticationSuccessHandler Class***

| No | Method | Description |
| :---: | :---- | :---- |
| 01 | **CustomAuthenticationSuccessHandler()** | **Purpose:** Constructor initializing default redirection targets. **Inputs:** None. **Outputs:** Newly created instance. **Internal processing:** Sets the default fallback redirection target URL to "/". |
| 02 | **onAuthenticationSuccess(request: HttpServletRequest, response: HttpServletResponse, authentication: Authentication): void** | **Purpose:** Handles post-login routing upon successful username/password authentication. **Inputs:** • *request: HttpServletRequest* – Current HTTP request. • *response: HttpServletResponse* – HTTP response used to perform redirection. • *authentication: Authentication* – Authentication token holding granted roles. **Outputs:** *void*. **Internal processing:** 1\. Checks priority order for redirect destination: explicit "redirect" parameter, session attribute "REDIRECT\_URL", or Spring Security SavedRequest. 2\. If authenticated user has ROLE\_ADMIN, redirects to /admin/novels (or valid /admin target). 3\. If user has ROLE\_STAFF, redirects to /staff/novels (or valid /staff target). 4\. For standard members, redirects to the requested valid return URL or "/". 5\. Clears authentication session attributes before triggering redirection. |
| 03 | **isValidRedirectUrl(url: String): boolean** | **Purpose:** Validates target redirection URLs to prevent Open Redirect security vulnerabilities. **Inputs:** *url: String* – URL string to validate. **Outputs:** *boolean* – true if relative, secure, and matching allowed paths; false otherwise. **Internal processing:** Checks that URL starts with "/", does not contain scheme identifiers (http:, https:), "//", or backslashes, and matches whitelisted application route prefixes. |
| 04 | **extractRelativePath(fullUrl: String): String** | **Purpose:** Extracts relative path component from full absolute URLs stored in SavedRequest. **Inputs:** *fullUrl: String* – Absolute URL string. **Outputs:** *String* – Relative URI path including query string. **Internal processing:** Parses URI and extracts the path and query portions. |

***CustomAuthenticationFailureHandler Class***

| No | Method | Description |
| :---: | :---- | :---- |
| 01 | **CustomAuthenticationFailureHandler(accountLockService: AccountLockService)** | **Purpose:** Constructor initializing the failure handler with the account lock service. **Inputs:** *accountLockService: AccountLockService* – Service for retrieving lock/ban details. **Outputs:** Newly created instance. **Internal processing:** Stores the accountLockService dependency. |
| 02 | **onAuthenticationFailure(request: HttpServletRequest, response: HttpServletResponse, exception: AuthenticationException): void** | **Purpose:** Intercepts form login failures and redirects banned/locked users to the ban details notice page, or returns login error query parameters. **Inputs:** • *request: HttpServletRequest* – Current request. • *response: HttpServletResponse* – Response used for redirect. • *exception: AuthenticationException* – Exception thrown during authentication. **Outputs:** *void*. **Internal processing:** 1\. If exception is LockedException: retrieves email from request parameter "username"; calls accountLockService.buildAccountLockedInfo(email) to fetch ban reasons/dates; stores AccountLockedInfoDTO into session attribute "LOCKED\_USER\_INFO"; redirects to "/account-locked". 2\. If exception is DisabledException: redirects to "/login?error=disabled" (prompting unverified users to verify email). 3\. For other credential exceptions (e.g. BadCredentialsException): redirects to "/login?error". |

***AccountLockService Class***

| No | Method | Description |
| :---: | :---- | :---- |
| 01 | **checkAndAutoUnban(user: User): boolean** | **Purpose:** Verifies whether a temporary ban has expired; automatically restores user status to ACTIVE if expiration time has passed. **Inputs:** *user: User* – Target user entity with status "BANNED". **Outputs:** *boolean* – true if the user was unbanned; false if the ban remains active or permanent. **Internal processing:** 1\. Queries systemAuditLogRepository for latest "BAN\_USER" audit record targeting this user. 2\. Parses ban expiration timestamp (banExpiresAt) from JSON audit log. 3\. If ban is temporary and current time is after expiresAt, updates status to "ACTIVE" and saves via userRepository. 4\. Logs an "AUTO\_UNBAN" audit record to system\_audit\_logs and returns true. |
| 02 | **buildAccountLockedInfo(email: String): AccountLockedInfoDTO** | **Purpose:** Builds and populates ban details DTO to present informative notice to locked users. **Inputs:** *email: String* – Email address of the locked user. **Outputs:** *AccountLockedInfoDTO* – Populated DTO containing ban reasons, dates, reviewer, and support email. **Internal processing:** Queries userRepository for user entity; fetches latest BAN\_USER audit log; extracts ban reason, duration, reviewer name, and ticket reference number; formats dates into localized display strings and constructs AccountLockedInfoDTO. |

***SecurityConfig Class***

| No | Method | Description |

| 01 | **filterChain(http: HttpSecurity): SecurityFilterChain** | **Purpose:** Configures Spring Security filter chain and defines user logout specifications. **Inputs:** *http: HttpSecurity* – Spring Security HTTP builder. **Outputs:** *SecurityFilterChain* – Configured security filter chain bean. **Internal processing:** 1\. Configures logout handling via logoutUrl("/logout") and sets logoutSuccessUrl("/"). 2\. Configures session invalidation and deletion of authentication cookies ("JSESSIONID", "remember-me"). 3\. Binds UserStatusCheckFilter before AuthorizationFilter to enforce status verification on protected requests. 4\. Configures route authorization allowing unauthenticated access to the homepage following logout. |

***UserStatusCheckFilter Class***

| No | Method | Description |
| :---: | :---- | :---- |
| 01 | **UserStatusCheckFilter(userRepository: UserRepository, accountLockService: AccountLockService)** | **Purpose:** Constructor initializing user status verification filter with data access and lock management services. **Inputs:** • *userRepository: UserRepository* – User persistence repository. • *accountLockService: AccountLockService* – Account lock evaluation service. **Outputs:** Newly created instance of *UserStatusCheckFilter*. **Internal processing:** Injects and binds dependencies to private final fields. |
| 02 | **shouldNotFilter(request: HttpServletRequest): boolean** | **Purpose:** Determines whether current HTTP request should bypass filter execution. **Inputs:** *request: HttpServletRequest* – Incoming servlet request. **Outputs:** *boolean* – true if request URI matches static assets (/css/\*\*, /js/\*\*, /images/\*\*) or public endpoints (/login, /logout, /register, /account-locked); false otherwise. **Internal processing:** Compares request URI against whitelisted public path prefixes and bypasses filtering for the logout endpoint ("/logout"). |
| 03 | **doFilterInternal(request: HttpServletRequest, response: HttpServletResponse, filterChain: FilterChain): void** | **Purpose:** Enforces active account checks on each request; blocks banned users from continuing their session. **Inputs:** • *request: HttpServletRequest* – Current HTTP request. • *response: HttpServletResponse* – Current HTTP response. • *filterChain: FilterChain* – Filter execution chain. **Outputs:** *void*. **Internal processing:** 1\. Inspects SecurityContextHolder for authenticated principal of type CustomUserDetails. 2\. If unauthenticated (such as after logout) or non-user principal, calls filterChain.doFilter(request, response) and exits. 3\. If authenticated, queries active user status from database via userRepository.findStatusById(userId). 4\. If status is "BANNED", evaluates auto-unban; if still banned, invalidates session, clears security context, clears remember-me cookie, and redirects to "/account-locked". 5\. Otherwise, passes execution along the filter chain. |

#### ***a. Class Diagram***

![][image12] 

#### 

#### ***b. Class Specifications***

***AuthController Class***

| No | Method | Description |
| :---: | :---- | :---- |
| 01 | **AuthController(authService: AuthService)** | **Purpose:** Constructor initializing authentication controller with authentication service dependency. **Inputs:** *authService: AuthService* – Authentication business service. **Outputs:** Newly created instance of *AuthController*. **Internal processing:** Injects and binds *AuthService* dependency to the private final field. |
| 02 | **showForgotPasswordForm(): String** | **Purpose:** Handles HTTP GET /forgot-password requests to display the forgot password email submission form. **Inputs:** None. **Outputs:** Returns String view template name "authentication/forgot-password". **Internal processing:** Renders and returns the forgot password input view. |
| 03 | **processForgotPassword(email: String, model: Model, redirectAttributes: RedirectAttributes): String** | **Purpose:** Handles HTTP POST /forgot-password requests to initiate password reset OTP generation and dispatch verification email. **Inputs:** • *email: String* – Account email address submitted by user. • *model: Model* – Spring MVC model for returning error messages to the view. • *redirectAttributes: RedirectAttributes* – Flash attributes holder for preserving success message across redirect. **Outputs:** Returns redirect URL String "redirect:/forgot-password/verify-otp?email=" \+ email on success, or view template "authentication/forgot-password" on error. **Internal processing:** 1\. Calls authService.sendForgotPasswordOtp(email) to validate account and dispatch OTP email. 2\. On success, adds flash attribute "successMessage" and redirects user to the OTP verification page. 3\. Catches IllegalArgumentException (e.g., account not found, OAuth account, banned account) or general Exception, populates "errorMessage" in model, and re-renders the forgot password form. |
| 04 | **showForgotPasswordVerifyOtpPage(email: String, model: Model): String** | **Purpose:** Handles HTTP GET /forgot-password/verify-otp requests to display OTP code entry screen. **Inputs:** • *email: String* – Email parameter passed in request URL. • *model: Model* – Spring MVC model for binding email attribute to the template. **Outputs:** Returns String view template name "authentication/forgot-password-verify-otp". **Internal processing:** Attaches email attribute to the model and returns the OTP verification view. |
| 05 | **processForgotPasswordVerifyOtp(email: String, otpCode: String, model: Model, request: HttpServletRequest): String** | **Purpose:** Handles HTTP POST /forgot-password/verify-otp requests to validate the submitted OTP code. **Inputs:** • *email: String* – Account email address. • *otpCode: String* – 6-digit verification code entered by user. • *model: Model* – Model for error messaging. • *request: HttpServletRequest* – HTTP servlet request to access user session. **Outputs:** Returns redirect URL String "redirect:/forgot-password/reset" on success, or view template "authentication/forgot-password-verify-otp" on error. **Internal processing:** 1\. Calls authService.verifyForgotPasswordOtp(email, otpCode) to validate OTP correctness and expiration. 2\. On success, stores "RESET\_PASSWORD\_EMAIL" in the HTTP session as authorization token for the next step. 3\. Redirects browser to "/forgot-password/reset". 4\. On failure, catches exception, sets "errorMessage" and retains "email" in model, and reloads OTP verification page. |
| 06 | **showResetPasswordForm(request: HttpServletRequest, model: Model): String** | **Purpose:** Handles HTTP GET /forgot-password/reset requests to display new password creation form. **Inputs:** • *request: HttpServletRequest* – HTTP servlet request to verify active session. • *model: Model* – Spring MVC model. **Outputs:** Returns view template "authentication/reset-password", or redirect "redirect:/forgot-password" if unauthorized. **Internal processing:** 1\. Checks if session exists and contains attribute "RESET\_PASSWORD\_EMAIL". 2\. If missing or invalid, redirects to "/forgot-password" to prevent unauthorized direct URL access. 3\. If authorized, renders view template "authentication/reset-password". |
| 07 | **processResetPassword(newPassword: String, confirmPassword: String, request: HttpServletRequest, model: Model, redirectAttributes: RedirectAttributes): String** | **Purpose:** Handles HTTP POST /forgot-password/reset requests to validate and update the account password. **Inputs:** • *newPassword: String* – New password entered by user. • *confirmPassword: String* – Password confirmation string. • *request: HttpServletRequest* – HTTP servlet request to access session attributes. • *model: Model* – Model for error messaging. • *redirectAttributes: RedirectAttributes* – Flash attributes holder for success notification. **Outputs:** Returns redirect URL "redirect:/login" on success, view template "authentication/reset-password" on error, or "redirect:/forgot-password" if unauthorized. **Internal processing:** 1\. Checks if session contains valid "RESET\_PASSWORD\_EMAIL"; redirects to "/forgot-password" if missing. 2\. Verifies newPassword matches confirmPassword; displays error if mismatched. 3\. Invokes authService.resetPassword(email, newPassword) to encode and persist password. 4\. Removes "RESET\_PASSWORD\_EMAIL" session attribute to prevent replay attacks. 5\. Adds flash attribute "successMessage" and redirects to "/login". 6\. On exception, catches error, populates "errorMessage" in model, and reloads reset password form. |

***AuthServiceImpl Class***

| No | Method | Description |
| :---: | :---- | :---- |
| 01 | **AuthServiceImpl(userRepository: UserRepository, roleRepository: RoleRepository, tokenRepository: EmailVerificationTokenRepository, passwordEncoder: PasswordEncoder, emailService: EmailService)** | **Purpose:** Constructor initializing authentication service with data repositories, password encoder, and email service. **Inputs:** • *userRepository: UserRepository* – User persistence repository. • *roleRepository: RoleRepository* – Role persistence repository. • *tokenRepository: EmailVerificationTokenRepository* – OTP verification token repository. • *passwordEncoder: PasswordEncoder* – BCrypt password hashing encoder. • *emailService: EmailService* – Service for sending email notifications. **Outputs:** Newly created instance of *AuthServiceImpl*. **Internal processing:** Injects and binds all dependencies to private final fields. |
| 02 | **sendForgotPasswordOtp(email: String): void** | **Purpose:** Validates account status, generates a 6-digit OTP code with 15-minute expiration, and dispatches recovery email. **Inputs:** *email: String* – Account email address requesting password reset. **Outputs:** *void*. **Internal processing:** 1\. Queries userRepository.findByEmail(email); throws IllegalArgumentException if account does not exist. 2\. Verifies user.getAuthProvider() equals "LOCAL"; throws IllegalArgumentException if user logged in via OAuth (e.g. Google). 3\. Verifies user.getStatus() is not "BANNED"; throws IllegalArgumentException if account is locked. 4\. Removes existing expired or unused OTP tokens via tokenRepository.deleteByUser(user). 5\. Generates random 6-digit numeric OTP code using Random and String.format("%06d", ...). 6\. Builds EmailVerificationToken with 15-minute expiration time (LocalDateTime.now().plusMinutes(15)) and saves via tokenRepository.save(token). 7\. Calls emailService.sendForgotPasswordOtpEmail(user.getEmail(), otp) to deliver code to user. |
| 03 | **verifyForgotPasswordOtp(email: String, otp: String): void** | **Purpose:** Verifies that the submitted OTP code matches the active token and has not expired. **Inputs:** • *email: String* – User email address. • *otp: String* – 6-digit OTP code to verify. **Outputs:** *void*. **Internal processing:** 1\. Queries user by email; throws IllegalArgumentException if not found. 2\. Queries tokenRepository.findByOtpCodeAndUser(otp, user); throws IllegalArgumentException if OTP code is incorrect. 3\. Checks token.getExpiryDate().isBefore(LocalDateTime.now()); throws IllegalArgumentException if token has expired. 4\. Exits normally upon successful verification. |
| 04 | **resetPassword(email: String, newPassword: String): void** | **Purpose:** Validates password complexity policy, encrypts new password, persists update, and removes OTP tokens. **Inputs:** • *email: String* – Target user account email. • *newPassword: String* – New plaintext password string. **Outputs:** *void*. **Internal processing:** 1\. Validates password complexity: must be at least 8 characters and contain at least one uppercase letter (matches ".\*\[A-Z\].\*"); throws IllegalArgumentException on violation. 2\. Queries userRepository.findByEmail(email); throws IllegalArgumentException if user not found. 3\. Hashes newPassword using passwordEncoder.encode(newPassword) and updates user.setPassword(...). 4\. Persists updated user via userRepository.save(user). 5\. Deletes all associated tokens for the user via tokenRepository.deleteByUser(user). |

### *2.2 Update Profile* {#2.2-update-profile}

#### ***a. Class Diagram***

![][image16] 

#### ***b. Class Specifications***

***UserController Class***

| No | Method | Description |
| :---: | :---- | :---- |
| 01 | **UserController(bookshelfService: BookshelfService, userService: UserService)** | **Purpose:** Constructor initializing user controller with bookshelf and user management service dependencies. **Inputs:** • *bookshelfService: BookshelfService* – Service for retrieving user profile summary data. • *userService: UserService* – Service for executing profile updates and file uploads. **Outputs:** Newly created instance of *UserController*. **Internal processing:** Injects and binds service dependencies to private final fields. |
| 02 | **viewEditProfile(authentication: Authentication, model: Model): String** | **Purpose:** Handles HTTP GET /user/edit-profile requests to render the profile editing page. **Inputs:** • *authentication: Authentication* – Current Spring Security principal context. • *model: Model* – Spring MVC model to pass current profile attributes. **Outputs:** Returns String view template name "user/edit-profile", or redirect "redirect:/login?redirect=/user/edit-profile" if unauthenticated. **Internal processing:** 1\. Checks if authentication is null, not authenticated, or an instance of AnonymousAuthenticationToken; redirects to login if so. 2\. Extracts authenticated user email via authentication.getName(). 3\. Calls bookshelfService.getUserProfile(email) to retrieve current profile DTO. 4\. Adds "userProfile" attribute to model and returns view template "user/edit-profile". |
| 03 | **updateProfile(authentication: Authentication, fullName: String, avatar: MultipartFile, redirectAttributes: RedirectAttributes): String** | **Purpose:** Handles HTTP POST /user/edit-profile requests to update user display name and upload new avatar. **Inputs:** • *authentication: Authentication* – Current security principal context. • *fullName: String* – Updated user display name string. • *avatar: MultipartFile* – Optional uploaded avatar image file. • *redirectAttributes: RedirectAttributes* – Flash attributes holder for feedback messages. **Outputs:** Returns redirect URL "redirect:/user/profile" on success, or "redirect:/user/edit-profile" on error. **Internal processing:** 1\. Validates authentication context; redirects to login if unauthenticated. 2\. Extracts user email via authentication.getName(). 3\. Calls userService.updateProfile(email, fullName, avatar) to process updates and upload avatar. 4\. Attaches flash attribute "successMessage" and redirects to "/user/profile". 5\. On exception, catches error, populates flash attribute "errorMessage", and redirects back to "/user/edit-profile". |

| 02 | **updateProfile(email: String, fullName: String, avatar: MultipartFile): void** | **Purpose:** Updates user full name, uploads avatar to Cloudinary if provided, and saves updated user entity. **Inputs:** • *email: String* – Account email address. • *fullName: String* – New display name. • *avatar: MultipartFile* – Optional uploaded avatar image file. **Outputs:** *void*. **Internal processing:** 1\. Queries userRepository.findByEmail(email); throws ResourceNotFoundException if user does not exist. 2\. If fullName is non-null and not blank, updates user.setFullName(fullName.trim()). 3\. If avatar is provided and not empty, calls mediaStorageService.uploadImage(avatar); sets returned secure URL via user.setAvatarUrl(avatarUrl). 4\. Persists updated user entity via userRepository.save(user). |

***UserController Class***

| No | Method | Description |
| :---: | :---- | :---- |
| 01 | **UserController(userService: UserService)** | **Purpose:** Constructor initializing user controller with user service dependency. **Inputs:** *userService: UserService* – Business service handling user account operations. **Outputs:** Newly created instance of *UserController*. **Internal processing:** Injects and binds *userService* dependency to private final field. |
| 02 | **viewChangePassword(authentication: Authentication): String** | **Purpose:** Handles HTTP GET /user/change-password requests to render the password change form. **Inputs:** *authentication: Authentication* – Current Spring Security authentication principal context. **Outputs:** Returns String view template name "user/change-password", or redirect "redirect:/login?redirect=/user/change-password" if unauthenticated. **Internal processing:** 1\. Checks if authentication is null, not authenticated, or an instance of AnonymousAuthenticationToken; redirects to login if unauthenticated. 2\. Returns logical view name "user/change-password". |
| 03 | **changePassword(authentication: Authentication, oldPassword: String, newPassword: String, redirectAttributes: RedirectAttributes): String** | **Purpose:** Handles HTTP POST /user/change-password requests to verify current password and apply new password update. **Inputs:** • *authentication: Authentication* – Current security principal context. • *oldPassword: String* – Current plaintext password entered by user. • *newPassword: String* – New plaintext password string. • *redirectAttributes: RedirectAttributes* – Flash attributes holder for feedback messages across redirect. **Outputs:** Returns redirect URL "redirect:/user/profile" on success, or "redirect:/user/change-password" on error. **Internal processing:** 1\. Validates authentication context; redirects to login if unauthenticated. 2\. Extracts authenticated user email via authentication.getName(). 3\. Invokes userService.changePassword(email, oldPassword, newPassword) to verify old password, hash new password, and persist updates. 4\. Adds flash attribute "successMessage" ("Đổi mật khẩu thành công") and redirects to "/user/profile". 5\. Catches IllegalArgumentException (e.g. incorrect old password), populates flash attribute "errorMessage", and redirects back to "/user/change-password". |

| No | Method | Description |
| :---: | :---- | :---- |
| 01 | **changePassword(email: String, oldPassword: String, newPassword: String): void** | **Purpose:** Service interface contract to authenticate current credentials and update user account password. **Inputs:** • *email: String* – Account email address of the user. • *oldPassword: String* – Current plaintext password for validation. • *newPassword: String* – New plaintext password to hash and store. **Outputs:** *void*. **Internal processing:** Declared abstract interface method; implemented by *UserServiceImpl*. |

***UserServiceImpl Class***

| No | Method | Description |
| :---: | :---- | :---- |
| 01 | **UserServiceImpl(userRepository: UserRepository, mediaStorageService: MediaStorageService, passwordEncoder: PasswordEncoder)** | **Purpose:** Constructor initializing user service implementation with persistence repository and security components. **Inputs:** • *userRepository: UserRepository* – User data persistence repository. • *mediaStorageService: MediaStorageService* – Media storage boundary service. • *passwordEncoder: PasswordEncoder* – BCrypt password hashing encoder. **Outputs:** Newly created instance of *UserServiceImpl*. **Internal processing:** Injects and assigns dependencies to private final class fields. |
| 02 | **changePassword(email: String, oldPassword: String, newPassword: String): void** | **Purpose:** Validates current user password against stored hash, encodes new password with BCrypt, and persists update. **Inputs:** • *email: String* – Account email address. • *oldPassword: String* – Current password string. • *newPassword: String* – New password string. **Outputs:** *void*. **Internal processing:** 1\. Queries userRepository.findByEmail(email); throws ResourceNotFoundException if user does not exist. 2\. Verifies passwordEncoder.matches(oldPassword, user.getPassword()); throws IllegalArgumentException ("Mật khẩu cũ không chính xác") if mismatch. 3\. Encrypts newPassword using passwordEncoder.encode(newPassword) and updates user.setPassword(...). 4\. Persists updated entity via userRepository.save(user). |

| 01 | **WalletController(walletService: WalletService, userRepository: UserRepository, systemSettingService: SystemSettingService)** | **Purpose:** Constructor initializing wallet controller with wallet service, user repository, and system setting service. **Inputs:** • *walletService: WalletService* – Business service handling wallet and transaction records. • *userRepository: UserRepository* – User data persistence repository. • *systemSettingService: SystemSettingService* – System setting service providing exchange rate values. **Outputs:** Newly created instance of *WalletController*. **Internal processing:** Injects and binds service and repository dependencies to private final fields. |
| 02 | **showWallet(authentication: Authentication, model: Model): String** | **Purpose:** Handles HTTP GET /wallet requests to render the personal wallet dashboard and transaction history view. **Inputs:** • *authentication: Authentication* – Current Spring Security principal context. • *model: Model* – Spring MVC model for passing wallet overview data to the view template. **Outputs:** Returns String view template name "wallet/index", or redirect "redirect:/login?redirect=/wallet" if unauthenticated. **Internal processing:** 1\. Validates authentication context; redirects to "/login" if unauthenticated. 2\. Resolves User entity via userRepository.findByEmail(authentication.getName()). 3\. Invokes walletService.getWalletOverview(user) to compute wallet balance, status, wallet code, and recent transactions. 4\. Attaches "wallet", "user", "vndToCoinRate", and "vndPerCoinFormatted" attributes to model. 5\. Returns view template "wallet/index". |
| 03 | **getTransactionsApi(authentication: Authentication, type: String, keyword: String, date: String, page: int, size: int): ResponseEntity\<Map\<String, Object\>\>** | **Purpose:** REST API endpoint handling HTTP GET /api/wallet/transactions for dynamic filtering and pagination of transactions. **Inputs:** • *authentication: Authentication* – Current security principal context. • *type: String* – Transaction filter type (e.g. "ALL", "DEPOSIT", "UNLOCK\_CHAPTER"). • *keyword: String* – Search keyword (title, description, or order code). • *date: String* – Date filter string in ISO format (YYYY-MM-DD). • *page: int* – Page index (0-indexed, default 0). • *size: int* – Page size (default 5). **Outputs:** *ResponseEntity\<Map\<String, Object\>\>* – JSON payload containing content list, currentPage, totalPages, totalElements, and isLast flag. **Internal processing:** 1\. Checks authentication status; returns HTTP 401 Unauthorized if unauthenticated. 2\. Retrieves User entity by authenticated email from userRepository. 3\. Parses date string into LocalDate if provided. 4\. Invokes walletService.searchTransactions(user, type, keyword, filterDate, page, size). 5\. Assembles pagination metadata map and returns HTTP 200 OK with JSON response. |

***WalletServiceImpl Class***

| No | Method | Description |
| :---: | :---- | :---- |
| 01 | **WalletServiceImpl(userRepository: UserRepository, transactionRepository: TransactionRepository, topupOrderRepository: TopupOrderRepository)** | **Purpose:** Constructor initializing wallet service implementation with repository dependencies. **Inputs:** • *userRepository: UserRepository* – User data persistence repository. • *transactionRepository: TransactionRepository* – Coin transaction ledger repository. • *topupOrderRepository: TopupOrderRepository* – Top-up order data repository. **Outputs:** Newly created instance of *WalletServiceImpl*. **Internal processing:** Injects and binds repository dependencies to private final fields. |
| 02 | **getWalletOverview(user: User): WalletOverviewDTO** | **Purpose:** Loads fresh user balance, computes wallet status, determines latest activity timestamp, and builds WalletOverviewDTO. **Inputs:** *user: User* – Target user entity. **Outputs:** *WalletOverviewDTO* – Wallet summary data transfer object. **Internal processing:** 1\. Reloads user by ID from userRepository to ensure updated balance. 2\. Formats balance with thousands separator and generates wallet code (e.g. \#WALLET-000123). 3\. Inspects transactionRepository and topupOrderRepository for most recent activity timestamp. 4\. Computes total transactions count and loads first page of transactions (size \= 5). 5\. Returns populated WalletOverviewDTO instance. |
| 03 | **searchTransactions(user: User, type: String, keyword: String, date: LocalDate, page: int, size: int): Page\<TransactionDTO\>** | **Purpose:** Filters transactions by type, text keyword, and creation date; aggregates ledger entries and failed topup orders into a paginated list. **Inputs:** • *user: User* – Associated user entity. • *type: String* – Transaction type (DEPOSIT, UNLOCK\_CHAPTER, DAILY\_CHECKIN, or null/ALL). • *keyword: String* – Search query matching description or order code. • *date: LocalDate* – Calendar date filter. • *page: int* – 0-indexed page index. • *size: int* – Maximum page size. **Outputs:** *Page\<TransactionDTO\>* – Paginated collection of TransactionDTOs. **Internal processing:** 1\. Queries ledger records from transactionRepository.findByUserIdOrderByCreatedAtDesc(user.getId()). 2\. Applies filters for type, date, and keyword. 3\. If type filter allows deposits, includes failed/cancelled orders from topupOrderRepository. 4\. Sorts aggregated items by timestamp descending. 5\. Slices sublist corresponding to requested page and size, wrapping in PageImpl. |

***PaymentController Class***

| No | Method | Description |
| :---: | :---- | :---- |
| 01 | **PaymentController(coinPackageService: CoinPackageService, vnPayService: VNPayService, userRepository: UserRepository, systemSettingService: SystemSettingService)** | **Purpose:** Constructor initializing payment controller with coin package service, VNPay gateway service, user repository, and system configuration service. **Inputs:** • *coinPackageService: CoinPackageService* – Service for retrieving active top-up packages. • *vnPayService: VNPayService* – Service handling VNPay gateway integration. • *userRepository: UserRepository* – User persistence repository. • *systemSettingService: SystemSettingService* – System setting provider for conversion rates. **Outputs:** Newly created instance of *PaymentController*. **Internal processing:** Injects and binds all dependencies to private final class fields. |
| 02 | **showTopupPage(authentication: Authentication, model: Model): String** | **Purpose:** Handles HTTP GET /wallet/topup requests to display the coin package selection and payment method interface. **Inputs:** • *authentication: Authentication* – Current Spring Security principal context. • *model: Model* – Spring MVC model for passing page data. **Outputs:** Returns String view template name "wallet/topup", or redirect "redirect:/login?redirect=/wallet/topup" if unauthenticated. **Internal processing:** 1\. Validates user authentication context; redirects to login if unauthenticated. 2\. Retrieves current User entity via userRepository.findByEmail(authentication.getName()). 3\. Calls coinPackageService.getActivePackages() to fetch all available active coin packages. 4\. Attaches user, walletBalance, packages, vndToCoinRate, and vndPerCoinFormatted attributes to model. 5\. Returns view template "wallet/topup". |
| 03 | **processTopup(authentication: Authentication, packageId: Integer, request: HttpServletRequest): String** | **Purpose:** Handles HTTP POST /wallet/topup/process requests to create a pending order and redirect the user to the VNPay Sandbox payment gateway. **Inputs:** • *authentication: Authentication* – Current user security context. • *packageId: Integer* – Selected coin package primary key. • *request: HttpServletRequest* – Servlet request for determining client IP address. **Outputs:** Returns redirect URL string to VNPay payment gateway ("redirect:" \+ vnpayUrl). **Internal processing:** 1\. Verifies authentication; redirects to login if unauthorized. 2\. Loads user entity by authenticated email from userRepository. 3\. Resolves client IP address via VNPayUtil.getIpAddress(request). 4\. Calls vnPayService.createPaymentUrl(user, packageId, clientIp) to persist a PENDING order and construct the signed payment gateway URL. 5\. Returns redirect to the generated VNPay gateway URL. |
| 04 | **handlePaymentReturn(allParams: Map\<String, String\>, model: Model): String** | **Purpose:** Handles HTTP GET /payment/vnpay-return requests when the user is redirected back to the platform following payment completion. **Inputs:** • *allParams: Map\<String, String\>* – Query parameters returned by VNPay gateway. • *model: Model* – Spring MVC model for passing payment result DTO to view. **Outputs:** Returns view template "wallet/payment-success" if payment succeeded, or "wallet/payment-failure" on failure/cancellation. **Internal processing:** 1\. Calls vnPayService.processReturn(allParams) to verify cryptographic checksum, update order status, and credit coins. 2\. Binds returned PaymentResultDTO to model attribute "result". 3\. Inspects result.isSuccess(): returns "wallet/payment-success" on true; "wallet/payment-failure" on false. |
| 05 | **handlePaymentIpn(allParams: Map\<String, String\>, request: HttpServletRequest): Map\<String, String\>** | **Purpose:** Webhook endpoint handling HTTP GET /api/payment/vnpay-ipn for server-to-server asynchronous transaction verification. **Inputs:** • *allParams: Map\<String, String\>* – URL request parameters dispatched by VNPay server. • *request: HttpServletRequest* – Servlet request to extract remote server IP address. **Outputs:** *Map\<String, String\>* – Response containing RspCode and Message complying with VNPay IPN protocol. **Internal processing:** 1\. Extracts remote IP address via VNPayUtil.getIpAddress(request). 2\. Invokes vnPayService.processIpn(allParams, clientIp) to record payload, verify signature, and fulfill order. 3\. Returns JSON map containing RspCode ("00", "01", "02", "04", "97") and Message. |

| 02 | **initPackages(): void** | **Purpose:** PostConstruct initialization method populating default coin packages if database table is empty. **Inputs:** None. **Outputs:** *void*. **Internal processing:** Checks if coinPackageRepository.count() \== 0; if true, persists standard tiers (20k, 50k, 100k, 200k, 500k, 1M VND). |
| 03 | **getActivePackages(): List\<CoinPackageDTO\>** | **Purpose:** Queries all ACTIVE coin packages, computes base and promotional bonus coins, and attaches UI badges. **Inputs:** None. **Outputs:** *List\<CoinPackageDTO\>* – Sorted list of coin package data transfer objects. **Internal processing:** 1\. Queries coinPackageRepository.findByStatusOrderByPriceAsc("ACTIVE"). 2\. Calculates baseCoin \= price / 100 and bonusCoin \= totalCoin \- baseCoin. 3\. Computes badge text (e.g. "+50 Tặng", "Tiết kiệm 10%", "Đại Gia VIP"). 4\. Constructs and returns list of CoinPackageDTO objects. |

***VNPayServiceImpl Class***

| No | Method | Description |
| :---: | :---- | :---- |
| 01 | **VNPayServiceImpl(vnPayProperties: VNPayProperties, coinPackageRepository: CoinPackageRepository, topupOrderRepository: TopupOrderRepository, paymentLogRepository: PaymentLogRepository, transactionRepository: TransactionRepository, userRepository: UserRepository)** | **Purpose:** Constructor initializing VNPay service implementation with configuration properties and persistence repositories. **Inputs:** Repositories for packages, orders, logs, transactions, users, and VNPay properties bean. **Outputs:** Newly created instance of *VNPayServiceImpl*. **Internal processing:** Injects and binds all dependencies to private final fields. |
| 02 | **createPaymentUrl(user: User, packageId: Integer, ipAddress: String): String** | **Purpose:** Generates unique order code, persists TopupOrder with PENDING status, and constructs HMAC-SHA512 signed VNPay URL. **Inputs:** • *user: User* – Payer user entity. • *packageId: Integer* – Package ID. • *ipAddress: String* – User IP address. **Outputs:** *String* – Complete VNPay payment gateway redirect URL. **Internal processing:** 1\. Loads CoinPackage by ID; generates order code (TT \+ timestamp \+ random suffix). 2\. Saves TopupOrder entity with status PENDING. 3\. Builds VNPay query map (vnp\_Amount \* 100, vnp\_TxnRef, vnp\_CreateDate, vnp\_ExpireDate). 4\. Computes secure HMAC-SHA512 hash and returns full redirect URL. |
| 03 | **processReturn(params: Map\<String, String\>): PaymentResultDTO** | **Purpose:** Validates cryptographic checksum of return parameters, updates order status, fulfills coins if successful, and builds result DTO. **Inputs:** *params: Map\<String, String\>* – Query parameters received from VNPay return. **Outputs:** *PaymentResultDTO* – Result summary data transfer object. **Internal processing:** 1\. Strips vnp\_SecureHash and recalculates HMAC-SHA512 checksum. 2\. Checks if checksum matches and responseCode \== "00". 3\. If valid and order is PENDING, calls fulfillOrder(order, transactionNo). 4\. If invalid, marks order as FAILED. 5\. Assembles and returns PaymentResultDTO. |
| 04 | **processIpn(params: Map\<String, String\>, ipAddress: String): Map\<String, String\>** | **Purpose:** Secure asynchronous IPN handler that logs raw payload, verifies signature, validates order amount, and confirms order. **Inputs:** • *params: Map\<String, String\>* – Parameter map from VNPay server. • *ipAddress: String* – Calling server IP. **Outputs:** *Map\<String, String\>* – VNPay response map (RspCode and Message). **Internal processing:** 1\. Persists raw payload into payment\_logs table. 2\. Validates HMAC-SHA512 checksum; returns RspCode "97" if invalid. 3\. Checks order existence; returns RspCode "01" if not found. 4\. Validates order amount; returns RspCode "04" if mismatched. 5\. Verifies order is PENDING; returns RspCode "02" if already confirmed. 6\. On responseCode "00", invokes fulfillOrder(order, transactionNo) and returns RspCode "00". |
| 05 | **fulfillOrder(order: TopupOrder, transactionNo: String): void** | **Purpose:** Synchronized internal method updating order to SUCCESS, crediting user wallet balance, and recording transaction ledger entry. **Inputs:** • *order: TopupOrder* – Order entity being fulfilled. • *transactionNo: String* – VNPay transaction reference code. **Outputs:** *void*. **Internal processing:** 1\. Verifies order is still PENDING to prevent duplicate fulfillment. 2\. Updates order status to SUCCESS, sets bankTransactionCode and paidAt. 3\. Credits order.getCoinReceived() to user wallet balance and saves user. 4\. Synchronizes session balance in SecurityContext if user is logged in. 5\. Persists credit ledger entry in transactions table with type "DEPOSIT". |
| 06 | **getFriendlyErrorMessage(responseCode: String): String** | **Purpose:** Translates VNPay numerical response codes into user-friendly localized explanation messages. **Inputs:** *responseCode: String* – VNPay response code string (e.g. "24", "51", "11"). **Outputs:** *String* – Localized error description. **Internal processing:** Maps response code through switch expression to descriptive Vietnamese message. |

#### ***d. Database Queries***

SELECT id, email, password, full\_name, avatar\_url, wallet\_balance, auth\_provider, status, created\_at, updated\_at FROM users WHERE email \= ?;

SELECT id, name, price, coin\_amount, status, created\_at FROM coin\_packages WHERE id \= ?;

INSERT INTO topup\_orders (user\_id, package\_id, order\_code, amount\_vnd, coin\_received, status, payment\_method, created\_at, updated\_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, 'PENDING', 'VNPAY', ?, ?);

SELECT id, user\_id, package\_id, order\_code, amount\_vnd, coin\_received, status, payment\_method, bank\_transaction\_code, paid\_at, created\_at, updated\_at FROM topup\_orders WHERE order\_code \= ?;

UPDATE topup\_orders SET status \= ?, bank\_transaction\_code \= ?, paid\_at \= ?, updated\_at \= ? WHERE id \= ?;

UPDATE users SET wallet\_balance \= wallet\_balance \+ ?, updated\_at \= ? WHERE id \= ?;

INSERT INTO transactions (user\_id, amount, balance\_after, type, reference\_id, description, created\_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, 'TOPUP', ?, ?, ?);
