| 01 | **TransactionAuditAdminController(transactionAuditService: TransactionAuditService)** | **Purpose:** Constructor for dependency injection of transaction audit business service. **Inputs:** transactionAuditService: TransactionAuditService. **Outputs:** Newly initialized instance. **Internal processing:** Binds transactionAuditService to the private final field. |
| 02 | **showAuditPage(startDate: String, endDate: String, type: String, orderCode: String, email: String, page: String, size: String, model: Model): String** | **Purpose:** Handles HTTP GET /admin/transactions to display the unified financial audit dashboard. **Inputs:** Filter parameters (startDate, endDate, type, orderCode, email), pagination (page, size), Spring UI Model. **Outputs:** View template name 'admin/transactions'. **Internal processing:** Validates date ranges (startDate \<= endDate), calls TransactionAuditService.getAuditStats() for KPI metrics, calls getAuditTransactions() for unified transaction records, and populates the model. |

***TransactionAuditService Interface***

| No | Method | Description |
| :---: | ----- | ----- |
| 01 | **getAuditStats(): TransactionAuditStatsDTO** | **Purpose:** Contract for aggregating financial metrics across all transactions. **Inputs:** None. **Outputs:** TransactionAuditStatsDTO containing totalTopupVnd, totalCoinsIssued, totalCoinsConsumed, and coinConsumptionRate. **Internal processing:** Contract specification for executing aggregation queries on topup\_orders and transactions. |
| 02 | **getAuditTransactions(startDate: LocalDate, endDate: LocalDate, type: String, orderCode: String, email: String, page: int, size: int): Page\<TransactionAuditDTO\>** | **Purpose:** Contract for retrieving paginated and filtered audit transactions. **Inputs:** Date filters, transaction type, search keywords, page and size. **Outputs:** Page\<TransactionAuditDTO\>. **Internal processing:** Contract specification for unified transaction querying combining deposits and ledger records. |

***TransactionAuditServiceImpl Class***

| No | Method | Description |
| :---: | ----- | ----- |
| 01 | **TransactionAuditServiceImpl(jdbcTemplate: NamedParameterJdbcTemplate, paymentLogRepository: PaymentLogRepository)** | **Purpose:** Constructor injecting JdbcTemplate and PaymentLogRepository dependencies. **Inputs:** jdbcTemplate: NamedParameterJdbcTemplate, paymentLogRepository: PaymentLogRepository. **Outputs:** Initialized TransactionAuditServiceImpl bean. **Internal processing:** Assigns dependencies to private final fields. |
| 02 | **getAuditStats(): TransactionAuditStatsDTO** | **Purpose:** Calculates real-time financial stats. **Inputs:** None. **Outputs:** TransactionAuditStatsDTO. **Internal processing:** Queries SUM(final\_amount) and SUM(coins) from topup\_orders where status='SUCCESS', SUM(ABS(amount)) from transactions where amount \< 0, and calculates consumption percentage. |
| 03 | **getAuditTransactions(startDate: LocalDate, endDate: LocalDate, type: String, orderCode: String, email: String, page: int, size: int): Page\<TransactionAuditDTO\>** | **Purpose:** Executes CTE SQL combining topup\_orders (source\_type='TOPUP') and transactions (source\_type='LEDGER') with dynamic filters. **Inputs:** Filter parameters and pagination indices. **Outputs:** Page\<TransactionAuditDTO\>. **Internal processing:** Builds dynamic WHERE clause, executes count query and paginated record query, maps ResultSet to TransactionAuditDTO. |

#### ***c. Sequence Diagram(s)***

![][image25]

#### ***d. Database Queries*** 

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(final\_amount), 0\) AS total\_vnd, COALESCE(SUM(coins), 0\) AS total\_coins FROM topup\_orders WHERE status \= 'SUCCESS';

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ABS(amount)), 0\) AS consumed\_coins FROM transactions WHERE amount \< 0;

WITH unified\_tx AS (SELECT id, user\_id, order\_code, final\_amount, coins, 'TOPUP' AS source\_type, created\_at FROM topup\_orders WHERE status \= 'SUCCESS' UNION ALL SELECT id, user\_id, NULL, 0, amount, 'LEDGER', created\_at FROM transactions WHERE type \!= 'DEPOSIT') SELECT \* FROM unified\_tx WHERE (:type IS NULL OR source\_type \= :type) ORDER BY created\_at DESC LIMIT :limit OFFSET :offset;

#### ***c. Sequence Diagram(s)***

![][image27]

#### ***d. Database Queries***

**1\. Retrieve public novel by slug**

SELECT id, title, slug, status, is\_deleted FROM novels WHERE slug \= ? AND is\_deleted \= FALSE AND status \<\> 'ARCHIVED';

**2\. Retrieve published chapter by novel ID and chapter number**

SELECT id, novel\_id, chapter\_number, title, price, status, is\_deleted FROM chapters WHERE novel\_id \= ? AND chapter\_number \= ? AND is\_deleted \= FALSE AND status IN ('PUBLISHED\_REGULAR', 'PUBLISHED\_VIP', 'PUBLISHED');

**3\. Retrieve chapter by ID for eligibility check**

SELECT id, novel\_id, chapter\_number, title, price, status, is\_deleted FROM chapters WHERE id \= ?;

**4\. Retrieve authenticated user by email**

SELECT id, email, full\_name, wallet\_balance, status FROM users WHERE email \= ?;

**5\. Check existing user chapter activity**

SELECT id, user\_id, chapter\_id, is\_read, read\_at, is\_unlocked, price\_paid, unlocked\_at FROM user\_chapter\_activities WHERE user\_id \= ? AND chapter\_id \= ?;

**6\. Deduct Coin price from user wallet balance**

UPDATE users SET wallet\_balance \= ?, updated\_at \= CURRENT\_TIMESTAMP WHERE id \= ?;

**7\. Insert UNLOCK\_CHAPTER transaction into wallet ledger**

INSERT INTO transactions (user\_id, amount, balance\_after, type, reference\_id, description, created\_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, 'UNLOCK\_CHAPTER', ?, ?, CURRENT\_TIMESTAMP) RETURNING id;

**8\. Record permanent VIP chapter unlock for new activity**

INSERT INTO user\_chapter\_activities (user\_id, chapter\_id, is\_unlocked, price\_paid, unlocked\_at) VALUES (?, ?, TRUE, ?, CURRENT\_TIMESTAMP) RETURNING id;

**9\. Update existing chapter activity to unlocked status**

UPDATE user\_chapter\_activities SET is\_unlocked \= TRUE, price\_paid \= ?, unlocked\_at \= CURRENT\_TIMESTAMP WHERE id \= ?;

The whole operation runs in one write transaction. |

| 04 | applyForm(novel : Novel, form : NovelForm) : void | **Purpose:** Map the submitted form onto the novel entity. **Inputs:** novel: Novel — the loaded target entity; form: NovelForm — the submitted data. **Outputs:** void — the entity is updated in place. **Internal processing:** Copy the trimmed title, author, summary and status to the entity; call mediaStorageService.uploadImage(form.getCover()) and set coverUrl when a non-blank URL is returned (the previous cover is kept when no new file is uploaded); when the slug is still empty, generate it from the trimmed title with SlugUtils.toSlug(); when the form contains category IDs, load them with categoryRepository.findAllById(form.getCategoryIds()) and set the resulting Set\<Category\>, otherwise set an empty set. |
| 05 | validateStatus(status : String) : void | **Purpose:** Validate the publishing status of the novel. **Inputs:** status: String — the status taken from the form. **Outputs:** void when the status is valid; otherwise IllegalArgumentException ("Trạng thái truyện không hợp lệ"). **Internal processing:** Check that the value belongs to the allowed set {ONGOING, COMPLETED, ON\_HOLD, ARCHIVED} and throw the exception when it does not. |

INSERT INTO novel\_categories (novel\_id, category\_id) VALUES (?, ?);

ChapterAdminController Class

| No | Method | Description |
| :---: | :---- | :---- |
| 01 | createForm(novelId : Integer) : String | **Purpose:** Render the Create Chapter screen of the internal Novel CMS. **Inputs:** novelId: Integer — the identifier of the parent novel taken from the request path. **Outputs:** The view name "admin/chapters/form"; when the novel does not exist, the redirect view "redirect:/admin/novels" with the flash message of the error. **Internal processing:** Call novelService.getEditableNovel(novelId) to load the parent novel and bind it as "novel"; bind a new empty ChapterForm as "chapterForm"; bind the page title "Tạo chương mới" and the form action "/admin/novels/" \+ novelId \+ "/chapters"; when the novel is not found, catch the ResourceNotFoundException, store its message as "errorMessage" and redirect to the Novel List. |
| 02 | createChapter(novelId : Integer, form : ChapterForm, action : ChapterSaveAction) : String | **Purpose:** Handle the submission of the Create Chapter form and save the new chapter. **Inputs:** novelId: Integer — the identifier of the parent novel; form: ChapterForm — the bound and validated form data; action: ChapterSaveAction — the requested save mode, DRAFT or PUBLISHED (default DRAFT). **Outputs:** The redirect view "redirect:/admin/novels/{novelId}/chapters" when the chapter is published, the redirect view "redirect:/admin/novels/{novelId}/chapters/{chapterId}/edit" when it is saved as a draft; the view name "admin/chapters/form" when the form has errors; the redirect view "redirect:/admin/novels" when the novel is not found. **Internal processing:** If bindingResult.hasErrors() is true, re-render the form with the current data; otherwise call chapterService.createChapter(novelId, form, action) and store the flash message "Đã tạo và xuất bản chương thành công." or "Đã lưu chương ở dạng bản nháp." depending on the save mode; when the chapter number already exists, catch the DuplicateResourceException, reject the "chapterNumber" field with the error message and re-render the form; when the novel is not found, catch the ResourceNotFoundException, store its message as "errorMessage" and redirect to the Novel List. |

| 02 | findActiveNovel(novelId : Integer) : Novel | **Purpose:** Find the parent novel by its identifier, ignoring the soft-deleted records. **Inputs:** novelId: Integer — the identifier of the novel. **Outputs:** The Novel entity; ResourceNotFoundException ("Không tìm thấy truyện") when the novel does not exist or has been deleted. **Internal processing:** Call novelRepository.findByIdAndIsDeletedFalse(novelId) and throw the exception when the result is empty. |
| 03 | resolvePrice(form : ChapterForm) : int | **Purpose:** Determine and validate the coin price of the new chapter. **Inputs:** form: ChapterForm — the submitted form data. **Outputs:** int — the valid price; IllegalArgumentException ("Giá Coin phải lớn hơn hoặc bằng 0") when the price is null or negative. **Internal processing:** Read form.getPrice(); if the value is null or lower than the default price 0, throw the exception; otherwise return the value unchanged. |
| 04 | resolveStatus(action : ChapterSaveAction, price : int) : String | **Purpose:** Derive the publishing status of the new chapter from the save mode and the price. **Inputs:** action: ChapterSaveAction — the requested save mode; price: int — the resolved price of the chapter. **Outputs:** String — "DRAFT" when the action is not PUBLISHED, "PUBLISHED\_VIP" when the action is PUBLISHED and the price is greater than 0, otherwise "PUBLISHED\_REGULAR". **Internal processing:** Return ChapterStatus.DRAFT when the action differs from PUBLISHED; when the action is PUBLISHED, compare the price with the default price 0 and return PUBLISHED\_VIP for a paid chapter, PUBLISHED\_REGULAR for a free chapter. |

NotificationService Interface

RichTextSanitizer Class

| No | Method | Description |
| :---: | :---- | :---- |
| 01 | sanitize(html : String) : String | **Purpose:** Remove the tags and attributes that are not supported by the chapter editor before the content is persisted. **Inputs:** html: String — the untrusted HTML produced by the rich text editor; a null value is treated as an empty string. **Outputs:** String — the safe HTML fragment to store in the content column. **Internal processing:** Parse the input with Jsoup.parseBodyFragment; run the Jsoup Cleaner against the allowed tag list (p, br, strong, b, em, i, u, s, h1–h3, ul, ol, li, blockquote, div, span, font); for each remaining element, filter the class attribute against the allowed CSS classes, remove the disallowed font face, size and colour values, keep only the font-size and line-height declarations of the style attribute, and remove an invalid align value of the div elements; finally return the cleaned body HTML trimmed. |

FROM novels WHERE id \= ? AND is\_deleted \= false and return the matched row. |

AND chapter\_number \= ? and convert the count into a boolean. |

#### ***c. Sequence Diagram(s)***

![][image37]

#### ***d. Database Queries***

SELECT id, title, slug, author, status FROM novels WHERE id \= ? AND is\_deleted \= FALSE;  
SELECT COUNT(\*) FROM chapters WHERE novel\_id \= ? AND chapter\_number \= ?;  
INSERT INTO chapters (novel\_id, chapter\_number, title, content, price, status, is\_deleted, views) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, FALSE, 0\) RETURNING id;  
INSERT INTO notifications (user\_id, title, content, is\_read, created\_at) SELECT b.user\_id, ?, ?, FALSE, NOW() FROM bookshelves b JOIN novels n ON n.id \= b.novel\_id JOIN chapters c ON c.id \= ? AND c.novel\_id \= b.novel\_id WHERE b.novel\_id \= ? AND n.is\_deleted \= false AND n.status \!= 'ARCHIVED' AND c.is\_deleted \= false AND c.status IN ('PUBLISHED\_REGULAR', 'PUBLISHED\_VIP') AND (? IS NULL OR b.user\_id \!= ?) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM notifications notif WHERE notif.user\_id \= b.user\_id AND notif.title \= ?);

ChapterAdminController Class

| No | Method | Description |
| :---: | :---- | :---- |
| 01 | editForm(novelId : Integer, chapterId : Integer) : String | **Purpose:** Render the Edit Chapter screen of the internal Novel CMS with the current chapter data. **Inputs:** novelId: Integer — the identifier of the parent novel; chapterId: Integer — the identifier of the chapter to edit, both taken from the request path. **Outputs:** The view name "admin/chapters/form"; when the novel or the chapter does not exist, the redirect view "redirect:/admin/novels" with the flash message of the error. **Internal processing:** Call novelService.getEditableNovel(novelId) to load the parent novel and bind it as "novel"; call chapterService.getEditableChapter(novelId, chapterId) to load the chapter and map its data onto a new ChapterForm bound as "chapterForm"; bind the page title "Chỉnh sửa chương" and the form action "/admin/novels/" \+ novelId \+ "/chapters/" \+ chapterId; when the resource is not found, catch the ResourceNotFoundException, store its message as "errorMessage" and redirect to the Novel List. |
| 02 | updateChapter(novelId : Integer, chapterId : Integer, form : ChapterForm, action : ChapterSaveAction) : String | **Purpose:** Handle the submission of the Edit Chapter form and persist the changes of the chapter. **Inputs:** novelId: Integer — the identifier of the parent novel; chapterId: Integer — the identifier of the chapter; form: ChapterForm — the bound and validated form data; action: ChapterSaveAction — the requested save mode, DRAFT or PUBLISHED (default DRAFT). **Outputs:** The redirect view "redirect:/admin/novels/{novelId}/chapters" when the chapter is published, the redirect view "redirect:/admin/novels/{novelId}/chapters/{chapterId}/edit" when it is saved as a draft; the view name "admin/chapters/form" when the form has errors; the redirect view "redirect:/admin/novels/{novelId}/chapters" when the novel or the chapter is not found. **Internal processing:** If bindingResult.hasErrors() is true, re-render the form with the current data; otherwise call chapterService.updateChapter(novelId, chapterId, form, action) and store the flash message "Đã cập nhật và xuất bản chương thành công." or "Đã lưu thay đổi ở dạng bản nháp." depending on the save mode; when the chapter number already exists in the novel, catch the DuplicateResourceException, reject the "chapterNumber" field with the error message and re-render the form; when the novel or the chapter is not found, catch the ResourceNotFoundException, store its message as "errorMessage" and redirect to the Chapter List. |

The whole operation runs in one read-only transaction. |
| 02 | updateChapter(novelId : Integer, chapterId : Integer, form : ChapterForm, action : ChapterSaveAction) : Chapter | **Purpose:** Apply the changes of the Edit Chapter form to an existing chapter. **Inputs:** novelId: Integer — the identifier of the parent novel; chapterId: Integer — the identifier of the chapter; form: ChapterForm — the validated form data; action: ChapterSaveAction — DRAFT or PUBLISHED. **Outputs:** The persisted Chapter entity; ResourceNotFoundException ("Không tìm thấy truyện" or "Không tìm thấy chương") when the novel or the chapter does not exist, DuplicateResourceException ("Số chương đã tồn tại trong truyện này") when the chapter number is already used by another chapter and IllegalArgumentException ("Giá Coin phải lớn hơn hoặc bằng 0") when the price is negative. **Internal processing:** Call findActiveNovel(novelId) and findActiveChapter(novelId, chapterId); remember the current status in oldStatus; call chapterRepository.existsByNovelIdAndChapterNumberAndIdNot(novelId, form.getChapterNumber(), chapterId) and throw the DuplicateResourceException when it returns true, so that the chapter keeps its own number; set the new chapter number, the trimmed title, the sanitized content, the resolved price and the resolved status on the entity; call chapterRepository.save(chapter) to persist the change; when the previous status was DRAFT and the new action is PUBLISHED, call notificationService.notifyNewChapterPublished(novelId, savedChapter.getId()) to inform the followers. The whole operation runs in one write transaction. |
| 03 | findActiveNovel(novelId : Integer) : Novel | **Purpose:** Find the parent novel by its identifier, ignoring the soft-deleted records. **Inputs:** novelId: Integer — the identifier of the novel. **Outputs:** The Novel entity; ResourceNotFoundException ("Không tìm thấy truyện") when the novel does not exist or has been deleted. **Internal processing:** Call novelRepository.findByIdAndIsDeletedFalse(novelId) and throw the exception when the result is empty. |
| 04 | findActiveChapter(novelId : Integer, chapterId : Integer) : Chapter | **Purpose:** Find the chapter by its identifier inside the given novel, ignoring the soft-deleted records. **Inputs:** novelId: Integer — the identifier of the parent novel; chapterId: Integer — the identifier of the chapter. **Outputs:** The Chapter entity; ResourceNotFoundException ("Không tìm thấy chương") when the chapter does not exist, has been deleted or does not belong to the novel. **Internal processing:** Call chapterRepository.findByIdAndNovelIdAndIsDeletedFalse(chapterId, novelId) and throw the exception when the result is empty. |

| 06 | resolveStatus(action : ChapterSaveAction, price : int) : String | **Purpose:** Derive the publishing status of the updated chapter from the save mode and the price. **Inputs:** action: ChapterSaveAction — the requested save mode; price: int — the resolved price of the chapter. **Outputs:** String — "DRAFT" when the action is not PUBLISHED, "PUBLISHED\_VIP" when the action is PUBLISHED and the price is greater than 0, otherwise "PUBLISHED\_REGULAR". **Internal processing:** Return ChapterStatus.DRAFT when the action differs from PUBLISHED; when the action is PUBLISHED, compare the price with the default price 0 and return PUBLISHED\_VIP for a paid chapter, PUBLISHED\_REGULAR for a free chapter. |

| 01 | DRAFT / PUBLISHED | **Purpose:** Enumerate the save modes available when the status of a chapter is changed. **Inputs:** none — the constants are declared by the enumeration. **Outputs:** DRAFT — the chapter is kept as a private draft; PUBLISHED — the chapter returns to the published state, either PUBLISHED\_REGULAR or PUBLISHED\_VIP according to its price. **Internal processing:** The enumeration is used as the type of the "saveAction" request parameter; Spring converts the submitted string to the matching constant and falls back to DRAFT when the parameter is absent. |

| 01 | updateChapter(novelId : Integer, chapterId : Integer, form : ChapterForm, action : ChapterSaveAction) : Chapter | **Purpose:** Apply the status change requested on a chapter, locking it with the LOCKED status or restoring it to the published status. **Inputs:** novelId: Integer — the identifier of the parent novel; chapterId: Integer — the identifier of the chapter; form: ChapterForm — the validated form data; action: ChapterSaveAction — DRAFT or PUBLISHED. **Outputs:** The persisted Chapter entity; ResourceNotFoundException ("Không tìm thấy truyện" or "Không tìm thấy chương") when the novel or the chapter does not exist, DuplicateResourceException ("Số chương đã tồn tại trong truyện này") when the chapter number is already used by another chapter and IllegalArgumentException ("Giá Coin phải lớn hơn hoặc bằng 0") when the price is negative. **Internal processing:** Call findActiveNovel(novelId) and findActiveChapter(novelId, chapterId); remember the current status in oldStatus; call chapterRepository.existsByNovelIdAndChapterNumberAndIdNot(novelId, form.getChapterNumber(), chapterId) and throw the DuplicateResourceException when it returns true; set the new chapter number, the trimmed title, the sanitized content and the resolved price on the entity; resolve the new status with resolveStatus(action, price), which returns DRAFT for a draft save, PUBLISHED\_VIP for a paid published chapter and PUBLISHED\_REGULAR for a free published chapter; when the chapter is being unlocked, the LOCKED status is replaced by the published status derived from its price; call chapterRepository.save(chapter) to persist the change; when the previous status was DRAFT and the new action is PUBLISHED, call notificationService.notifyNewChapterPublished(novelId, savedChapter.getId()) to inform the followers. The whole operation runs in one write transaction. |
| 02 | findActiveNovel(novelId : Integer) : Novel | **Purpose:** Find the parent novel by its identifier, ignoring the soft-deleted records. **Inputs:** novelId: Integer — the identifier of the novel. **Outputs:** The Novel entity; ResourceNotFoundException ("Không tìm thấy truyện") when the novel does not exist or has been deleted. **Internal processing:** Call novelRepository.findByIdAndIsDeletedFalse(novelId) and throw the exception when the result is empty. |
| 03 | findActiveChapter(novelId : Integer, chapterId : Integer) : Chapter | **Purpose:** Find the chapter by its identifier inside the given novel, ignoring the soft-deleted records. **Inputs:** novelId: Integer — the identifier of the parent novel; chapterId: Integer — the identifier of the chapter. **Outputs:** The Chapter entity with its current status; ResourceNotFoundException ("Không tìm thấy chương") when the chapter does not exist, has been deleted or does not belong to the novel. **Internal processing:** Call chapterRepository.findByIdAndNovelIdAndIsDeletedFalse(chapterId, novelId) and throw the exception when the result is empty; the loaded status decides whether the chapter is locked or unlocked. |
| 04 | resolveStatus(action : ChapterSaveAction, price : int) : String | **Purpose:** Derive the new publishing status of the chapter from the save mode and the price. **Inputs:** action: ChapterSaveAction — the requested save mode; price: int — the resolved price of the chapter. **Outputs:** String — "DRAFT" when the action is not PUBLISHED, "PUBLISHED\_VIP" when the action is PUBLISHED and the price is greater than 0, otherwise "PUBLISHED\_REGULAR". **Internal processing:** Return ChapterStatus.DRAFT when the action differs from PUBLISHED; when the action is PUBLISHED, compare the price with the default price 0 and return PUBLISHED\_VIP for a paid chapter, PUBLISHED\_REGULAR for a free chapter; the LOCKED status is only left behind by the explicit lock operation and is replaced by these values when the chapter is unlocked. |

| No | Method | Description |
| :---: | :---- | :---- |
| 01 | sanitize(html : String) : String | **Purpose:** Remove the tags and attributes that are not supported by the chapter editor before the content is persisted. **Inputs:** html: String — the untrusted HTML produced by the rich text editor; a null value is treated as an empty string. **Outputs:** String — the safe HTML fragment to store in the content column. **Internal processing:** Parse the input with Jsoup.parseBodyFragment; run the Jsoup Cleaner against the allowed tag list (p, br, strong, b, em, i, u, s, h1–h3, ul, ol, li, blockquote, div, span, font); for each remaining element, filter the class attribute against the allowed CSS classes, remove the disallowed font face, size and colour values, keep only the font-size and line-height declarations of the style attribute, and remove an invalid align value of the div elements; finally return the cleaned body HTML trimmed. |

NovelRepository Class

| No | Method | Description |
| :---: | :---- | :---- |
| 01 | findByIdAndIsDeletedFalse(id : Integer) : Novel | **Purpose:** Read the parent novel of the reconfigured chapter, excluding the soft-deleted records. **Inputs:** id: Integer — the identifier of the novel. **Outputs:** The Novel entity; an empty result when no active novel has that identifier. **Internal processing:** Execute SELECT ... FROM novels WHERE id \= ? AND is\_deleted \= false and return the matched row. |

ChapterRepository Class

| No | Method | Description |
| :---: | :---- | :---- |
| 01 | findByIdAndNovelIdAndIsDeletedFalse(chapterId : Integer, novelId : Integer) : Chapter | **Purpose:** Read the chapter being reconfigured, excluding the soft-deleted records and the chapters belonging to another novel. **Inputs:** chapterId: Integer — the identifier of the chapter; novelId: Integer — the identifier of the parent novel. **Outputs:** The Chapter entity with its current price and status; an empty result when no active chapter matches both conditions. **Internal processing:** Execute SELECT ... FROM chapters WHERE id \= ? AND novel\_id \= ? AND is\_deleted \= false and return the matched row. |
| 02 | save(chapter : Chapter) : Chapter | **Purpose:** Persist the chapter after the new price and the new status have been applied. **Inputs:** chapter: Chapter — the managed entity carrying the new configuration values. **Outputs:** The managed Chapter entity with the refreshed updated\_at timestamp. **Internal processing:** Because the entity already carries its primary key, Hibernate issues an UPDATE on the table chapters for the columns price and status (and for the other changed columns), and the database refreshes updated\_at. |

Novel Class

| No | Method | Description |
| :---: | :---- | :---- |
| 01 | getId() : Integer / getTitle() : String | **Purpose:** Provide the identity and the display name of the parent novel. **Inputs:** none. **Outputs:** The novel ID and the novel title displayed on the chapter list after the reconfiguration. **Internal processing:** Read the values from the mapped row of the table novels. |

Chapter Class

| No | Method | Description |
| :---: | :---- | :---- |
| 01 | setPrice(price : Integer) : void | **Purpose:** Set the new coin price of the reconfigured chapter. **Inputs:** price: Integer — the resolved price, 0 for a free chapter or a positive value for a paid VIP chapter. **Outputs:** void — the entity is updated in place and persisted by the service layer. **Internal processing:** Assign the value to the mapped price field; the price decides the access policy applied to the chapter, because a paid chapter requires an unlock by the reader before its content can be read. |
| 02 | setStatus(status : ChapterStatus) : void | **Purpose:** Set the new publishing status of the reconfigured chapter. **Inputs:** status: ChapterStatus — DRAFT, PUBLISHED\_REGULAR or PUBLISHED\_VIP, derived from the save mode and the new price. **Outputs:** void — the entity is updated in place and persisted by the service layer. **Internal processing:** Assign the value to the mapped status field; when the price is raised above 0 the chapter becomes PUBLISHED\_VIP and the readers must pay the new price to unlock it, when the price is set back to 0 the chapter becomes PUBLISHED\_REGULAR and is readable for free. |
| 03 | getId() : Integer / getPrice() : Integer / getStatus() : ChapterStatus | **Purpose:** Provide the identity and the current configuration of the chapter. **Inputs:** none. **Outputs:** The chapter ID, the current coin price and the current status; the old price and the old status are recorded for the audit trail of the configuration change. **Internal processing:** Read the values from the managed entity before the update. |

ChapterStatus Class

| No | Method | Description |
| :---: | :---- | :---- |
| 01 | DRAFT / PUBLISHED\_REGULAR / PUBLISHED\_VIP / LOCKED | **Purpose:** Enumerate the editorial, security and access states of a chapter. **Inputs:** none — the constants are declared by the enumeration. **Outputs:** DRAFT ("Bản nháp") — the chapter is private and not visible to the readers; PUBLISHED\_REGULAR ("Xuất bản thường") — the chapter is public and free; PUBLISHED\_VIP ("Xuất bản VIP") — the chapter is public but requires a paid unlock; LOCKED ("Đã khóa") — the chapter is hidden from the readers by the staff. **Internal processing:** The enumeration is stored as the name of the status column of the table chapters; when a chapter is reconfigured the status is recomputed from the new price, so the value PUBLISHED\_VIP means that the access policy requires a paid unlock, while the value LOCKED is only set by the explicit lock operation. |

#### ***d. Database Queries***

SELECT id, title, slug, author, status FROM novels WHERE id \= ? AND is\_deleted \= FALSE;  
SELECT id, novel\_id, chapter\_number, title, content, price, status, is\_deleted FROM chapters WHERE id \= ? AND novel\_id \= ? AND is\_deleted \= FALSE;  
UPDATE chapters SET price \= ?, status \= ?, updated\_at \= CURRENT\_TIMESTAMP WHERE id \= ? AND novel\_id \= ? AND is\_deleted \= FALSE;  
INSERT INTO system\_audit\_logs (admin\_id, action\_type, target\_entity, target\_id, old\_value, new\_value, ip\_address) VALUES (?, 'CONFIGURE\_CHAPTER', 'CHAPTERS', ?, ?, ?, ?);

#### ***c. Sequence Diagram(s)***

![][image57]

#### ***d. Database Queries***

SELECT DISTINCT n.id, n.title, n.slug, n.author, n.summary, n.cover\_url, n.status, n.views, n.average\_rating, n.chapter\_count, n.created\_at, n.updated\_at FROM novels n WHERE n.is\_deleted \= false AND (LOWER(n.title) LIKE LOWER(CONCAT('%', ?, '%')) OR LOWER(n.author) LIKE LOWER(CONCAT('%', ?, '%'))) AND n.status \<\> 'ARCHIVED' ORDER BY n.updated\_at DESC LIMIT ? OFFSET ?;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT n.id) FROM novels n WHERE n.is\_deleted \= false AND (LOWER(n.title) LIKE LOWER(CONCAT('%', ?, '%')) OR LOWER(n.author) LIKE LOWER(CONCAT('%', ?, '%'))) AND n.status \<\> 'ARCHIVED';

SELECT c.id, c.name, c.slug, c.description, (SELECT COUNT(\*) FROM novel\_categories nc JOIN novels n ON nc.novel\_id \= n.id WHERE nc.category\_id \= c.id AND n.is\_deleted \= false) AS novelCount FROM categories c ORDER BY c.id ASC;

AND n.status \= COALESCE(?, n.status) AND n.status \<\> 'ARCHIVED' ORDER BY n.updated\_at DESC LIMIT ? OFFSET ?;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT n.id) FROM novels n JOIN novel\_categories nc ON n.id \= nc.novel\_id WHERE n.is\_deleted \= false AND nc.category\_id IN (?, ?) AND n.status \= COALESCE(?, n.status) AND n.status \<\> 'ARCHIVED';

SELECT c.id, c.name, c.slug, c.description, (SELECT COUNT(\*) FROM novel\_categories nc JOIN novels n ON nc.novel\_id \= n.id WHERE nc.category\_id \= c.id AND n.is\_deleted \= false) AS novelCount FROM categories c ORDER BY c.id ASC;

### ***7.4 View Novel Details*** {#7.4-view-novel-details}

#### ***a. Class Diagram***

![][image62] 

#### ***b. Class Specifications***

***NovelController Class***

| No | Method | Description |
| :---: | :---- | :---- |
| 01 | **novelDetailsBySlug** | **\- Input:** slug: String, authentication: Authentication, model: Model. **\- Output:** String (View name "novel/details"). **\- Internal Method Processing:** Handles GET /truyen/{slug} request. Retrieves the public novel by slug via novelService.getPublicNovelBySlug(slug) and fetches its published table of contents via chapterService.getPublicChapters(novelId). If the user is authenticated, checks bookshelf membership (isNovelInBookshelf), reading history existence (hasReadAnyChapter), and latest read chapter bookmark (getLastReadChapter). Also fetches total favorites (countNovelFavorites) and related works by the same author (getNovelsBySameAuthor), binds all attributes to the Model, and renders "novel/details". |

***NovelService Interface***

| No | Method | Description |
| :---: | :---- | :---- |
| 01 | **getPublicNovelBySlug** | **\- Input:** slug: String. **\- Output:** Novel. **\- Internal Method Processing:** Retrieves an active, non-archived novel matching the given URL slug or throws ResourceNotFoundException if not found. |
| 02 | **getNovelsBySameAuthor** | **\- Input:** author: String, currentNovelId: Integer. **\- Output:** List\<Novel\>. **\- Internal Method Processing:** Retrieves up to 5 public novels written by the same author (excluding the current novel) ordered by views descending. |

***NovelServiceImpl Class***

| No | Method | Description |
| :---: | :---- | :---- |
| 01 | **getPublicNovelBySlug** | **\- Input:** slug: String. **\- Output:** Novel. **\- Internal Method Processing:** Validates that slug is non-blank and queries novelRepository.findBySlugAndIsDeletedFalseAndStatusNot(slug, "ARCHIVED"). Throws ResourceNotFoundException if the novel does not exist, is soft-deleted, or is archived. |
| 02 | **getNovelsBySameAuthor** | **\- Input:** author: String, currentNovelId: Integer. **\- Output:** List\<Novel\>. **\- Internal Method Processing:** Queries novelRepository.findTop5ByAuthorIgnoreCaseAndIdNotAndIsDeletedFalseOrderByViewsDesc() and filters out archived novels to display related titles by the same author. |

***ChapterService Interface***

| No | Method | Description |
| :---: | :---- | :---- |
| 01 | **getPublicChapters** | **\- Input:** novelId: Integer. **\- Output:** List\<Chapter\>. **\- Internal Method Processing:** Retrieves all publicly published chapters belonging to the specified novel ordered by chapter number ascending. |

***ChapterServiceImpl Class***

| No | Method | Description |
| :---: | :---- | :---- |
| 01 | **getPublicChapters** | **\- Input:** novelId: Integer. **\- Output:** List\<Chapter\>. **\- Internal Method Processing:** Verifies that the parent novel is public via novelRepository.findByIdAndIsDeletedFalseAndStatusNot(novelId, "ARCHIVED"), then calls chapterRepository.findAllByNovelIdAndIsDeletedFalseAndStatusInOrderByChapterNumberAsc() with public statuses (PUBLISHED\_REGULAR, PUBLISHED\_VIP, PUBLISHED). |

***BookshelfService Interface***

| No | Method | Description |
| :---: | :---- | :---- |
| 01 | **isNovelInBookshelf** | **\- Input:** email: String, novelId: Integer. **\- Output:** boolean. **\- Internal Method Processing:** Checks whether the authenticated user has already saved the novel in their personal bookshelf. |
| 02 | **hasReadAnyChapter** | **\- Input:** email: String, novelId: Integer. **\- Output:** boolean. **\- Internal Method Processing:** Checks whether the user has read at least one chapter of the novel. |
| 03 | **countNovelFavorites** | **\- Input:** novelId: Integer. **\- Output:** long. **\- Internal Method Processing:** Returns the total number of readers who bookmarked the novel in their bookshelf. |
| 04 | **getLastReadChapter** | **\- Input:** email: String, novelId: Integer. **\- Output:** Optional\<Chapter\>. **\- Internal Method Processing:** Retrieves the most recently read chapter of the novel for the "Continue Reading" button. |

***BookshelfServiceImpl Class***

| No | Method | Description |
| :---: | :---- | :---- |
| 01 | **isNovelInBookshelf** | **\- Input:** email: String, novelId: Integer. **\- Output:** boolean. **\- Internal Method Processing:** Looks up the User by email and the Novel by ID, then calls bookshelfRepository.existsByUserAndNovel(user, novel). Returns false if not found. |
| 02 | **hasReadAnyChapter** | **\- Input:** email: String, novelId: Integer. **\- Output:** boolean. **\- Internal Method Processing:** Looks up the User and Novel entities and checks if userChapterActivityRepository.countByUserAndChapter\_NovelAndIsReadTrue(user, novel) \> 0\. |
| 03 | **countNovelFavorites** | **\- Input:** novelId: Integer. **\- Output:** long. **\- Internal Method Processing:** Delegates to bookshelfRepository.countByNovelId(novelId) to return total favorites. |
| 04 | **getLastReadChapter** | **\- Input:** email: String, novelId: Integer. **\- Output:** Optional\<Chapter\>. **\- Internal Method Processing:** Queries userChapterActivityRepository.findFirstByUserAndChapter\_NovelAndIsReadTrueOrderByReadAtDescChapter\_ChapterNumberDesc(user, novel) and extracts the non-deleted Chapter entity. |

| No | Method | Description |

#### ***c. Sequence Diagram(s)***

![][image63]

#### ***d. Database Queries***

**1\. Retrieve public novel by slug**

SELECT id, title, slug, author, summary, cover\_url, status, is\_deleted, uploader\_id, views, average\_rating, rating\_count, created\_at, updated\_at FROM novels WHERE slug \= ? AND is\_deleted \= FALSE AND status \<\> 'ARCHIVED';

**2\. Verify public novel by ID**

SELECT id, title, slug, author, summary, cover\_url, status, is\_deleted, uploader\_id, views, average\_rating, rating\_count, created\_at, updated\_at FROM novels WHERE id \= ? AND is\_deleted \= FALSE AND status \<\> 'ARCHIVED';

**3\. Retrieve all published chapters of the novel**

SELECT id, novel\_id, chapter\_number, title, price, status, views, created\_at, updated\_at FROM chapters WHERE novel\_id \= ? AND is\_deleted \= FALSE AND status IN ('PUBLISHED\_REGULAR', 'PUBLISHED\_VIP', 'PUBLISHED') ORDER BY chapter\_number ASC;

**4\. Retrieve authenticated user by email**

SELECT id, email, password, full\_name, avatar\_url, wallet\_balance, auth\_provider, status, created\_at, updated\_at FROM users WHERE email \= ?;

**5\. Check if novel is in user's bookshelf**

SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM bookshelves WHERE user\_id \= ? AND novel\_id \= ?);

**6\. Count read chapters of the novel for the user**

SELECT COUNT(uca.id) FROM user\_chapter\_activities uca INNER JOIN chapters c ON uca.chapter\_id \= c.id WHERE uca.user\_id \= ? AND c.novel\_id \= ? AND uca.is\_read \= TRUE;

**7\. Retrieve latest read chapter activity for "Continue Reading"**

SELECT uca.id, uca.user\_id, uca.chapter\_id, uca.is\_read, uca.read\_at, c.chapter\_number, c.title, c.status FROM user\_chapter\_activities uca INNER JOIN chapters c ON uca.chapter\_id \= c.id WHERE uca.user\_id \= ? AND c.novel\_id \= ? AND uca.is\_read \= TRUE ORDER BY uca.read\_at DESC, c.chapter\_number DESC LIMIT 1;

**8\. Count total bookshelf favorites for the novel**

SELECT COUNT(id) FROM bookshelves WHERE novel\_id \= ?;

**9\. Retrieve top 5 novels by the same author**

SELECT id, title, slug, author, summary, cover\_url, status, views, average\_rating, rating\_count FROM novels WHERE LOWER(author) \= LOWER(?) AND id \<\> ? AND is\_deleted \= FALSE ORDER BY views DESC LIMIT 5;

#### ***d. Database Queries***

SELECT DISTINCT n.id, n.title, n.slug, n.author, n.cover\_url, n.views, n.average\_rating, n.status, n.updated\_at FROM novels n JOIN novel\_categories nc ON n.id \= nc.novel\_id WHERE nc.category\_id \= ? AND n.is\_deleted \= false AND n.status \<\> 'ARCHIVED' ORDER BY n.views DESC;

SELECT n.id, n.title, n.slug, n.author, n.cover\_url, n.views, n.average\_rating, n.status, n.updated\_at FROM novels n WHERE n.is\_deleted \= false AND n.status \<\> 'ARCHIVED' ORDER BY n.views DESC;

SELECT id, name, slug, description FROM categories ORDER BY id ASC;

### ***7.6 View Novel List*** {#7.6-view-novel-list}

#### ***a. Class Diagram***

![][image66] 

#### ***b. Class Specifications***

HomeController Class

| No | Method | Description |
| :---: | :---- | :---- |
| 01 | **home** | **\- Input:** `authentication: Authentication`, `model: Model`. **\- Output:** `String` (View name `"home/index"`). **\- Internal Method Processing:** Handles `GET /` request to display the public novel list on the homepage. Invokes `homeService.getHomePageData()` to retrieve categorized novel lists (recently updated, hot/most-viewed, completed, recommended, and newly created novels). Extracts the top 5 hot novels for the hero banner, checks whether the featured hero novel is already in the authenticated user's bookshelf via `bookshelfService.isNovelInBookshelf()`, populates the Spring MVC `Model`, and returns the `"home/index"` view. |

HomeService Interface

| No | Method | Description |
| :---: | :---- | :---- |
| 01 | **getHomePageData** | **\- Input:** None. **\- Output:** `HomePageDTO`. **\- Internal Method Processing:** Defines the service contract to aggregate and return all public novel lists displayed on the homepage. |

HomeServiceImpl Class

| No | Method | Description |
| :---: | :---- | :---- |
| 01 | **getHomePageData** | **\- Input:** None. **\- Output:** `HomePageDTO`. **\- Internal Method Processing:** Queries `NovelRepository` for five homepage sections: top 12 recently updated novels, top 10 hot novels by view count, top 12 completed novels, top 12 recommended novels (having at least one published chapter, ordered by average rating and views), and top 12 newly added novels. Filters out archived novels using `publicNovels()`, transforms each `Novel` entity into a `NovelSummaryDTO` via `mapToSummaryDTO()`, and builds the aggregated `HomePageDTO` object. |
| 02 | **mapToSummaryDTO** | **\- Input:** `novel: Novel`, `includeChapters: boolean`. **\- Output:** `NovelSummaryDTO`. **\- Internal Method Processing:** Queries `bookshelfRepository.countByNovelId()` to get the total favorite count for the novel. If `includeChapters` is `true`, queries `chapterRepository.findTop3ByNovelIdAndIsDeletedFalseAndStatusInOrderByChapterNumberDesc()` to fetch up to 3 latest published chapters and maps them to `LatestChapterDTO` with formatted relative timestamps. Constructs and returns a `NovelSummaryDTO`. |
| 03 | **publicNovels** | **\- Input:** `novels: List<Novel>`. **\- Output:** `List<Novel>`. **\- Internal Method Processing:** Filters the input list of novels to exclude any novel whose status is `"ARCHIVED"`, ensuring only publicly visible novels are returned. |

BookshelfService Interface

| No | Method | Description |
| :---: | :---- | :---- |
| 01 | **isNovelInBookshelf** | **\- Input:** `email: String`, `novelId: Integer`. **\- Output:** `boolean`. **\- Internal Method Processing:** Checks whether the specified novel (featured in the homepage hero banner) is already saved in the authenticated user's personal bookshelf. |

NovelRepository Interface

| No | Method | Description |
| :---: | :---- | :---- |
| 01 | **findTop12ByIsDeletedFalseOrderByUpdatedAtDesc** | **\- Input:** None. **\- Output:** `List<Novel>`. **\- Internal Method Processing:** Retrieves the top 12 non-deleted novels ordered by `updated_at` descending for the "Recently Updated" section. |
| 02 | **findTop10ByIsDeletedFalseOrderByViewsDesc** | **\- Input:** None. **\- Output:** `List<Novel>`. **\- Internal Method Processing:** Retrieves the top 10 non-deleted novels ordered by total `views` descending for the "Hot Novels" ranking and hero banner. |
| 03 | **findTop12ByIsDeletedFalseAndStatusOrderByUpdatedAtDesc** | **\- Input:** `status: String` (`"COMPLETED"`). **\- Output:** `List<Novel>`. **\- Internal Method Processing:** Retrieves the top 12 non-deleted novels matching the given status (`COMPLETED`) ordered by `updated_at` descending. |
| 04 | **findTopRecommendedNovels** | **\- Input:** `publicStatuses: Collection<String>`, `pageable: Pageable`. **\- Output:** `List<Novel>`. **\- Internal Method Processing:** Executes a custom JPQL query to fetch non-deleted, non-archived novels that have at least one published chapter, ordered by `average_rating` descending and `views` descending. |
| 05 | **findTop12ByIsDeletedFalseOrderByCreatedAtDesc** | **\- Input:** None. **\- Output:** `List<Novel>`. **\- Internal Method Processing:** Retrieves the top 12 non-deleted novels ordered by `created_at` descending for the "New Novels" section. |

ChapterRepository Interface

| No | Method | Description |
| :---: | :---- | :---- |
| 01 | **findTop3ByNovelIdAndIsDeletedFalseAndStatusInOrderByChapterNumberDesc** | **\- Input:** `novelId: Integer`, `statuses: List<String>`. **\- Output:** `List<Chapter>`. **\- Internal Method Processing:** Retrieves up to 3 latest non-deleted published chapters (`PUBLISHED_REGULAR`, `PUBLISHED_VIP`) for a given novel ordered by `chapter_number` descending. |

BookshelfRepository Interface

| No | Method | Description |
| :---: | :---- | :---- |
| 01 | **countByNovelId** | **\- Input:** `novelId: Integer`. **\- Output:** `long`. **\- Internal Method Processing:** Counts the total number of users who have saved the specified novel in their personal bookshelf. |

#### ***c. Sequence Diagram(s)***

![][image67]

#### ***d. Database Queries***

**1\. Retrieve all active novel categories**

SELECT id, name, slug, description FROM categories ORDER BY name ASC;

**2\. Retrieve top 12 recently updated novels**

SELECT id, title, slug, author, summary, cover\_url, status, is\_deleted, uploader\_id, views, average\_rating, rating\_count, created\_at, updated\_at FROM novels WHERE is\_deleted \= FALSE ORDER BY updated\_at DESC LIMIT 12;

**3\. Retrieve top 10 hot novels by view count**

SELECT id, title, slug, author, summary, cover\_url, status, is\_deleted, uploader\_id, views, average\_rating, rating\_count, created\_at, updated\_at FROM novels WHERE is\_deleted \= FALSE ORDER BY views DESC LIMIT 10;

**4\. Retrieve top 12 completed novels**

SELECT id, title, slug, author, summary, cover\_url, status, is\_deleted, uploader\_id, views, average\_rating, rating\_count, created\_at, updated\_at FROM novels WHERE is\_deleted \= FALSE AND status \= ? ORDER BY updated\_at DESC LIMIT 12;

**5\. Retrieve top 12 recommended public novels**

SELECT n.id, n.title, n.slug, n.author, n.summary, n.cover\_url, n.status, n.is\_deleted, n.uploader\_id, n.views, n.average\_rating, n.rating\_count, n.created\_at, n.updated\_at FROM novels n WHERE n.is\_deleted \= FALSE AND n.status \<\> 'ARCHIVED' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM chapters c WHERE c.novel\_id \= n.id AND c.is\_deleted \= FALSE AND c.status IN ('PUBLISHED\_REGULAR', 'PUBLISHED\_VIP', 'PUBLISHED')) ORDER BY n.average\_rating DESC, n.views DESC LIMIT 12 OFFSET 0;

**6\. Retrieve top 12 newly created novels**

SELECT id, title, slug, author, summary, cover\_url, status, is\_deleted, uploader\_id, views, average\_rating, rating\_count, created\_at, updated\_at FROM novels WHERE is\_deleted \= FALSE ORDER BY created\_at DESC LIMIT 12;

**7\. Check if hero featured novel is in authenticated user's bookshelf**

SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM bookshelves WHERE user\_id \= ? AND novel\_id \= ?);

**8\. Count total bookshelf favorites for a novel**

SELECT COUNT(id) FROM bookshelves WHERE novel\_id \= ?;

**9\. Retrieve top 3 latest published chapters per novel**

SELECT id, novel\_id, chapter\_number, title, price, status, views, created\_at, updated\_at FROM chapters WHERE novel\_id \= ? AND is\_deleted \= FALSE AND status IN ('PUBLISHED\_REGULAR', 'PUBLISHED\_VIP', 'PUBLISHED') ORDER BY chapter\_number DESC LIMIT 3;

#### ***d. Database Queries***

SELECT \* FROM novel WHERE slug \= ? AND is\_deleted \= false AND status \!= 'ARCHIVED';

SELECT \* FROM user WHERE email \= ?;

SELECT \* FROM novel WHERE id \= ? AND is\_deleted \= false;

SELECT COUNT(\*) FROM user\_chapter\_activity WHERE user\_id \= ? AND novel\_id \= ? AND is\_read \= true;

SELECT \* FROM novel\_rating WHERE novel\_id \= ? AND user\_id \= ?;

INSERT INTO novel\_rating (novel\_id, user\_id, rating, review\_text, ...) VALUES (...);

SELECT AVG(r.rating) FROM novel\_rating r WHERE r.novel\_id \= ?;

SELECT COUNT(\*) FROM novel\_rating WHERE novel\_id \= ?;

UPDATE novel SET rating\_average \= ?, rating\_count \= ? WHERE id \= ?;

### ***9.1 Report Comment*** {#9.1-report-comment}

#### ***a. Class Diagram***

**![][image74]**

#### ***b. Class Specifications***

***ReportController Class***

| No | Method | Description |
| :---: | ----- | ----- |
| 01 | **ReportController(reportService: ReportService, userRepository: UserRepository)** | **Purpose:** Constructor injecting ReportService and UserRepository. **Inputs:** reportService: ReportService, userRepository: UserRepository. **Outputs:** Initialized ReportController instance. **Internal processing:** Binds dependencies to fields. |
| 02 | **reportComment(request: ReportCommentRequest, bindingResult: BindingResult, authentication: Authentication): ResponseEntity\<?\>** | **Purpose:** Endpoint POST /reports/comment to report an inappropriate comment. **Inputs:** request: ReportCommentRequest, bindingResult: BindingResult, authentication: Authentication. **Outputs:** ResponseEntity\<?\> JSON message. **Internal processing:** Validates login state, validates request payload, extracts authenticated userId, calls ReportService.reportComment(userId, request), returns 200 OK on success or 400/409 error. |

***ReportService Interface***

| No | Method | Description |
| :---: | ----- | ----- |
| 01 | **reportComment(userId: Integer, request: ReportCommentRequest): void** | **Purpose:** Contract to record a user report on a comment. **Inputs:** userId: Integer, request: ReportCommentRequest. **Outputs:** void. **Internal processing:** Contract for validating comment status, checking duplicate reports, and saving CommentReport entity. |

***ReportServiceImpl Class***

| No | Method | Description |
| :---: | ----- | ----- |
| 01 | **ReportServiceImpl(commentRepository: CommentRepository, commentReportRepository: CommentReportRepository, userRepository: UserRepository)** | **Purpose:** Constructor for ReportServiceImpl. **Inputs:** Injected repositories. **Outputs:** Initialized bean. **Internal processing:** Injects dependencies. |
| 02 | **reportComment(userId: Integer, request: ReportCommentRequest): void** | **Purpose:** Business logic for reporting comments. **Inputs:** userId: Integer, request: ReportCommentRequest. **Outputs:** void. **Internal processing:** Checks comment exists and status \== 'VISIBLE', verifies no pending RECEIVED report by same user, composes compositeReason, creates and saves CommentReport with status 'RECEIVED'. |

***CommentReportRepository Interface***

| No | Method | Description |
| :---: | ----- | ----- |
| 01 | **existsByUserIdAndCommentIdAndStatusIn(userId: Integer, commentId: Integer, statuses: Collection\<String\>): boolean** | **Purpose:** Checks for pending reports by the same user on a comment. **Inputs:** userId: Integer, commentId: Integer, statuses: Collection\<String\>. **Outputs:** boolean. **Internal processing:** Spring Data JPA count query. |
| 02 | **save(report: CommentReport): CommentReport** | **Purpose:** Persists comment report entity. **Inputs:** report: CommentReport. **Outputs:** CommentReport. **Internal processing:** Executes SQL INSERT/UPDATE. |

***CommentRepository Interface***

| No | Method | Description |
| :---: | ----- | ----- |
| 01 | **findById(id: Integer): Optional\<Comment\>** | **Purpose:** Finds comment by ID. **Inputs:** id: Integer. **Outputs:** Optional\<Comment\>. **Internal processing:** Executes SELECT \* FROM comment WHERE id \= ?. |

***UserRepository Interface***

| No | Method | Description |

Verifies that the user is authenticated; if not, redirects to the login page. Invokes bookshelfService.getBookshelfPage(email, filter, q, sort, page, 8\) to fetch filtered, sorted, and paginated bookshelf items (8 items per page) along with reading statistics, adds bookshelfPage to the Model, and returns the "user/bookshelf" view. |

| No | Method | Description |
| :---: | :---- | :---- |
| 01 | **getBookshelfPage** | **\- Input:** email: String, filter: String, query: String, sort: String, page: int, size: int. **\- Output:** BookshelfPageDTO. **\- Internal Method Processing:** Retrieves the member's personal bookshelf page with reading progress percentages, tab filtering, keyword search, sorting, and pagination. |

***BookshelfServiceImpl Class***

| No | Method | Description |
| :---: | :---- | :---- |
| 01 | **getBookshelfPage** | **\- Input:** email: String, filter: String, query: String, sort: String, page: int, size: int. **\- Output:** BookshelfPageDTO. **\- Internal Method Processing:** Retrieves the User by email via userRepository.findByEmail() and fetches all saved bookshelf records with their associated non-deleted novels via bookshelfRepository.findAllByUserWithNovel(user). Maps each entry to a BookshelfItemDTO using mapToBookshelfItem(). Computes summary counts (totalCount, readingCount, completedCount), applies keyword search on title/author, filters by status tab (ALL, READING, COMPLETED), sorts by recent, name, or progress, paginates the list (8 items/page), and returns a BookshelfPageDTO. |
| 02 | **mapToBookshelfItem** | **\- Input:** user: User, bookshelf: Bookshelf. **\- Output:** BookshelfItemDTO. **\- Internal Method Processing:** Queries chapterRepository.countByNovelIdAndIsDeletedFalse() for total chapters and existsByNovelIdAndPriceGreaterThanAndIsDeletedFalse() for VIP badge detection. Queries userChapterActivityRepository for the latest read chapter and total read chapter count. Calculates progressPercentage (0–100%), completion flags (isCompleted, isCaughtUp), and target readUrl, then constructs and returns a BookshelfItemDTO. |

***UserRepository Interface***

| No | Method | Description |
| :---: | :---- | :---- |

***ChapterRepository Interface***

| No | Method | Description |

#### ***c. Sequence Diagram(s)***

![][image82]

#### ***d. Database Queries***

**1\. Retrieve authenticated user by email**

SELECT id, email, full\_name, avatar\_url, wallet\_balance, status, created\_at FROM users WHERE email \= ?;

**2\. Retrieve all bookshelf entries with active novels for the user**

SELECT b.id, b.user\_id, b.novel\_id, b.added\_at, n.id AS novel\_id, n.title, n.slug, n.author, n.cover\_url, n.status, n.is\_deleted FROM bookshelves b INNER JOIN novels n ON b.novel\_id \= n.id WHERE b.user\_id \= ? AND n.is\_deleted \= FALSE ORDER BY b.added\_at DESC;

**3\. Count total non-deleted chapters of a novel**

SELECT COUNT(id) FROM chapters WHERE novel\_id \= ? AND is\_deleted \= FALSE;

**4\. Check if novel has paid VIP chapters**

SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM chapters WHERE novel\_id \= ? AND price \> 0 AND is\_deleted \= FALSE);

**5\. Retrieve latest read chapter activity for a novel**

SELECT uca.id, uca.user\_id, uca.chapter\_id, uca.is\_read, uca.read\_at, c.chapter\_number, c.title FROM user\_chapter\_activities uca INNER JOIN chapters c ON uca.chapter\_id \= c.id WHERE uca.user\_id \= ? AND c.novel\_id \= ? AND uca.is\_read \= TRUE ORDER BY uca.read\_at DESC, c.chapter\_number DESC LIMIT 1;

**6\. Count chapters read by user for a novel**

SELECT COUNT(uca.id) FROM user\_chapter\_activities uca INNER JOIN chapters c ON uca.chapter\_id \= c.id WHERE uca.user\_id \= ? AND c.novel\_id \= ? AND uca.is\_read \= TRUE;

Iterates through each record: if isUnlocked \== true, resets isRead \= false and readAt \= null and saves; otherwise deletes the record. |
| 04 | **mapToHistoryDTO** | **\- Input:** activity: UserChapterActivity. **\- Output:** ReadingHistoryItemDTO. **\- Internal Method Processing:** Extracts novel metadata (ID, title, slug, author, cover URL), chapter metadata (ID, number, title, VIP flag), and readAt timestamp from the UserChapterActivity entity into a ReadingHistoryItemDTO. |

| :---: | :---- | :---- |
| 01 | **findAllByUserAndIsReadTrueOrderByReadAtDesc** | **\- Input:** user: User, pageable: Pageable. **\- Output:** Page\<UserChapterActivity\>. **\- Internal Method Processing:** Queries all chapter activity records where is\_read \= TRUE for the given user, sorted by read\_at DESC. |
| 02 | **findByUserAndChapterId** | **\- Input:** user: User, chapterId: Integer. **\- Output:** Optional\<UserChapterActivity\>. **\- Internal Method Processing:** Finds a specific user-chapter activity record by user entity and chapter ID. |
| 03 | **save** | **\- Input:** activity: UserChapterActivity. **\- Output:** UserChapterActivity. **\- Internal Method Processing:** Updates the activity record (setting is\_read \= FALSE and read\_at \= NULL) when clearing reading history for an unlocked VIP chapter. |
| 04 | **delete** | **\- Input:** activity: UserChapterActivity. **\- Output:** void. **\- Internal Method Processing:** Deletes the activity record when removing reading history for a regular (non-unlocked) chapter. |

#### ***c. Sequence Diagram(s)***

![][image88]

#### 

#### ***d. Database Queries***

**1\. Retrieve authenticated user by email**

SELECT id, email, full\_name, status FROM users WHERE email \= ?;

**2\. Retrieve paginated reading history with chapter and novel details**

SELECT uca.id, uca.user\_id, uca.chapter\_id, uca.is\_read, uca.read\_at, uca.is\_unlocked, c.chapter\_number, c.title AS chapter\_title, c.price, n.id AS novel\_id, n.title AS novel\_title, n.slug AS novel\_slug, n.author, n.cover\_url FROM user\_chapter\_activities uca INNER JOIN chapters c ON uca.chapter\_id \= c.id INNER JOIN novels n ON c.novel\_id \= n.id WHERE uca.user\_id \= ? AND uca.read\_at IS NOT NULL ORDER BY uca.read\_at DESC LIMIT ? OFFSET ?;

**3\. Find user chapter activity by user ID and chapter ID**

SELECT id, user\_id, chapter\_id, is\_read, read\_at, is\_unlocked, price\_paid, unlocked\_at FROM user\_chapter\_activities WHERE user\_id \= ? AND chapter\_id \= ?;

**4\. Reset reading flag while preserving VIP unlock record**

UPDATE user\_chapter\_activities SET is\_read \= FALSE, read\_at \= NULL WHERE id \= ?;

**5\. Delete reading history record for non-VIP chapter**

DELETE FROM user\_chapter\_activities WHERE id \= ?;

#### ***d. Database Queries***

**1\. Retrieve public novel by slug**

SELECT id, title, slug, author, summary, cover\_url, status, is\_deleted, views, average\_rating, rating\_count FROM novels WHERE slug \= ? AND is\_deleted \= FALSE AND status \<\> 'ARCHIVED';

**2\. Retrieve published chapter by novel ID and chapter number**

SELECT id, novel\_id, chapter\_number, title, content, price, auto\_unlock\_at, views, status, is\_deleted, created\_at, updated\_at FROM chapters WHERE novel\_id \= ? AND chapter\_number \= ? AND is\_deleted \= FALSE AND status IN ('PUBLISHED\_REGULAR', 'PUBLISHED\_VIP', 'PUBLISHED');

**3\. Increment chapter view count**

UPDATE chapters SET views \= views \+ 1, updated\_at \= CURRENT\_TIMESTAMP WHERE id \= ?;

**4\. Increment novel cumulative view count**

UPDATE novels SET views \= views \+ 1, updated\_at \= CURRENT\_TIMESTAMP WHERE id \= ?;

**5\. Retrieve authenticated user by email**

SELECT id, email, full\_name, wallet\_balance, status FROM users WHERE email \= ?;

**6\. Check user's unlock and reading activity for the chapter**

SELECT id, user\_id, chapter\_id, is\_read, read\_at, is\_unlocked, price\_paid, unlocked\_at FROM user\_chapter\_activities WHERE user\_id \= ? AND chapter\_id \= ?;

**7\. Retrieve all published chapters for previous/next chapter navigation**

SELECT id, novel\_id, chapter\_number, title, price, status FROM chapters WHERE novel\_id \= ? AND is\_deleted \= FALSE AND status IN ('PUBLISHED\_REGULAR', 'PUBLISHED\_VIP', 'PUBLISHED') ORDER BY chapter\_number ASC;

| No | Method | Description |

Verifies user authentication, retrieves current check-in streak and 7-day roadmap via dailyCheckinService.getCheckinStatus(email) and wallet balance via walletService.getBalance(email), binds them to the model, and renders the check-in page. |
| 02 | **getCheckinStatusApi** | **\- Input:** authentication: Authentication. **\- Output:** ResponseEntity\<DailyCheckinStatusDTO\>. **\- Internal Method Processing:** Handles GET /user/checkin/api/status AJAX request for the check-in popup widget. Returns HTTP 401 if unauthenticated; otherwise returns HTTP 200 with the user's DailyCheckinStatusDTO. |
| 03 | **performCheckin** | **\- Input:** authentication: Authentication, request: HttpServletRequest, redirectAttributes: RedirectAttributes. **\- Output:** Object (ResponseEntity\<DailyCheckinResultDTO\> for AJAX or redirect URL String). **\- Internal Method Processing:** Handles POST /user/checkin request. Verifies user authentication, executes the daily check-in reward claim via dailyCheckinService.performCheckin(email), and returns the DailyCheckinResultDTO as JSON (for AJAX requests) or sets flash attributes and redirects to /user/checkin. |

***DailyCheckinService Interface***

| No | Method | Description |
| :---: | :---- | :---- |
| 01 | **getCheckinStatus** | **\- Input:** email: String. **\- Output:** DailyCheckinStatusDTO. **\- Internal Method Processing:** Retrieves the user's current check-in state, consecutive day streak, and 7-day reward roadmap. |
| 02 | **performCheckin** | **\- Input:** email: String. **\- Output:** DailyCheckinResultDTO. **\- Internal Method Processing:** Records today's check-in, calculates the streak reward Coins, credits the user's wallet, and returns the check-in result. |

***DailyCheckinServiceImpl Class***

| No | Method | Description |
| :---: | :---- | :---- |
| 01 | **getCheckinStatus** | **\- Input:** email: String. **\- Output:** DailyCheckinStatusDTO. **\- Internal Method Processing:** Resolves the User by email, checks if a record exists for today via checkinRepository.findByUserAndCheckinDate(user, today), and inspects the most recent check-in via checkinRepository.findTopByUserOrderByCheckinDateDesc(user). Determines the active 1..7 cycle day (resetting to Day 1 if the streak was broken or completed Day 7), counts total check-in days via checkinRepository.countByUser(user), sums accumulated reward coins via checkinRepository.sumRewardCoinByUser(user), constructs the 7-day roadmap via buildRoadmap(), and returns DailyCheckinStatusDTO. |
| 02 | **performCheckin** | **\- Input:** email: String. **\- Output:** DailyCheckinResultDTO. **\- Internal Method Processing:** Resolves the User by email and checks checkinRepository.existsByUserAndCheckinDate(user, today); if already checked in today, returns an unsuccessful DailyCheckinResultDTO. Otherwise, inspects yesterday's check-in via checkinRepository.findByUserAndCheckinDate(user, yesterday) to compute newStreak (1 to 7), determines rewardCoin (15 Coins on Day 7, 5 Coins on Days 1-6), saves the new UserDailyCheckin record, credits the user's wallet via walletService.addCoins(user, rewardCoin, "GIFT\_COIN", checkinId, description), and returns the updated DailyCheckinResultDTO. |
| 03 | **buildRoadmap** | **\- Input:** currentCycleDay: int, isCheckedInToday: boolean. **\- Output:** List\<DayRoadmapItemDTO\>. **\- Internal Method Processing:** Generates the 7-day check-in roadmap items (Days 1-6 with 5 Coins, Day 7 with 15 Coins) and assigns each day's status (CLAIMED, TODAY, or UPCOMING). |

| 01 | **findByUserAndCheckinDate** | **\- Input:** user: User, checkinDate: LocalDate. **\- Output:** Optional\<UserDailyCheckin\>. **\- Internal Method Processing:** Retrieves the user's check-in record for a specific calendar date (today or yesterday). |
| 02 | **findTopByUserOrderByCheckinDateDesc** | **\- Input:** user: User. **\- Output:** Optional\<UserDailyCheckin\>. **\- Internal Method Processing:** Retrieves the user's most recent check-in record ordered by checkin\_date DESC. |
| 03 | **existsByUserAndCheckinDate** | **\- Input:** user: User, checkinDate: LocalDate. **\- Output:** boolean. **\- Internal Method Processing:** Checks whether the user has already checked in on the specified date. |
| 04 | **countByUser** | **\- Input:** user: User. **\- Output:** long. **\- Internal Method Processing:** Counts the total number of daily check-ins completed by the user. |
| 05 | **sumRewardCoinByUser** | **\- Input:** user: User. **\- Output:** Long. **\- Internal Method Processing:** Calculates the total accumulated reward coins earned by the user across all daily check-ins. |
| 06 | **save** | **\- Input:** checkin: UserDailyCheckin. **\- Output:** UserDailyCheckin. **\- Internal Method Processing:** Inserts a new daily check-in record into the user\_daily\_checkins table. |

***TransactionRepository Interface***

| No | Method | Description |
| :---: | :---- | :---- |
| 01 | **save** | **\- Input:** transaction: Transaction. **\- Output:** Transaction. **\- Internal Method Processing:** Inserts a new reward Coin ledger transaction (type \= 'GIFT\_COIN') into the transactions table. |

#### ***c. Sequence Diagram(s)![][image96]***

#### ***d. Database Queries***

**1\. Retrieve authenticated user by email**

SELECT id, email, full\_name, wallet\_balance, status FROM users WHERE email \= ?;

**2\. Find user check-in record for a specific date**

SELECT id, user\_id, checkin\_date, reward\_coin, streak\_count, created\_at FROM user\_daily\_checkins WHERE user\_id \= ? AND checkin\_date \= ?;

**3\. Retrieve most recent check-in record for streak calculation**

SELECT id, user\_id, checkin\_date, reward\_coin, streak\_count, created\_at FROM user\_daily\_checkins WHERE user\_id \= ? ORDER BY checkin\_date DESC LIMIT 1;

**4\. Count total check-in days for user**

SELECT COUNT(id) FROM user\_daily\_checkins WHERE user\_id \= ?;

**5\. Calculate total accumulated check-in reward coins for user**

SELECT SUM(reward\_coin) FROM user\_daily\_checkins WHERE user\_id \= ?; 

**6\. Check if user has already checked in today**

SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM user\_daily\_checkins WHERE user\_id \= ? AND checkin\_date \= CURRENT\_DATE);

**7\. Insert new daily check-in record**

INSERT INTO user\_daily\_checkins (user\_id, checkin\_date, reward\_coin, streak\_count, created\_at) VALUES (?, CURRENT\_DATE, ?, ?, CURRENT\_TIMESTAMP) RETURNING id;

**8\. Update user wallet balance with reward Coins**

UPDATE users SET wallet\_balance \= ?, updated\_at \= CURRENT\_TIMESTAMP WHERE id \= ?;

**9\. Insert GIFT\_COIN reward transaction into wallet ledger**

INSERT INTO transactions (user\_id, amount, balance\_after, type, reference\_id, description, created\_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, 'GIFT\_COIN', ?, ?, CURRENT\_TIMESTAMP) RETURNING id;

SELECT COUNT(\*) FROM system\_audit\_logs WHERE created\_at \>= ?;

SELECT \* FROM system\_audit\_logs WHERE id \= ?;
